1	"""Shared machinery for analysis modules.
2	
3	A module is an object with a ``name``, a ``title`` and an async ``run(ctx, out)``.
4	It reports through ``out`` (a Reporter): progress, findings and artifacts. The
5	case runner turns those calls into JSON events that the web UI streams.
6	"""
7	
8	import asyncio
9	import itertools
10	import json
11	import os
12	import subprocess
13	import time
14	from collections.abc import Awaitable
15	from collections.abc import Callable
16	from dataclasses import asdict
17	from dataclasses import dataclass
18	from dataclasses import field
19	from typing import Any
20	from typing import Literal
21	from typing import Protocol
22	
23	import numpy as np
24	
25	from earwitness import media
26	from earwitness._common import ForensicError
27	
28	Severity = Literal["info", "notice", "warning", "critical"]
29	Kind = Literal["measured", "inferred"]
30	
31	_finding_ids = itertools.count(1)
32	
33	
34	@dataclass(slots=True)
35	class Finding:
36	    module: str
37	    severity: Severity
38	    title: str
39	    detail: str
40	    time_s: float | None = None
41	    time_end_s: float | None = None
42	    kind: Kind = "measured"
43	    tags: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
44	    data: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
45	    id: str = ""
46	
47	
48	@dataclass(slots=True)
49	class Artifact:
50	    module: str
51	    name: str
52	    kind: str
53	    title: str
54	    url: str | None = None
55	    data: Any = None
56	    time_s: float | None = None
57	    id: str = ""
58	
59	
60	class Emit(Protocol):
61	    def __call__(self, event: dict[str, Any]) -> None: ...
62	
63	
64	class Reporter:
65	    """What a module uses to talk to the outside world."""
66	
67	    def __init__(self, module: str, case: "CaseContext", emit: Emit) -> None:
68	        self._module = module
69	        self._case = case
70	        self._emit = emit
71	        self._last_progress = -1.0
72	
73	    def progress(self, fraction: float, message: str = "") -> None:
74	        fraction = float(min(1.0, max(0.0, fraction)))
75	
76	        if fraction - self._last_progress < 0.01 and not message:
77	            return
78	
79	        self._last_progress = fraction
80	        self._emit(
81	            {
82	                "type": "module",
83	                "module": self._module,
84	                "status": "running",
85	                "progress": round(fraction, 3),
86	                "message": message,
87	            }
88	        )
89	
90	    def log(self, message: str) -> None:
91	        self._emit({"type": "log", "module": self._module, "message": message})
92	
93	    def finding(
94	        self,
95	        severity: Severity,
96	        title: str,
97	        detail: str,
98	        **extra: Any,
99	    ) -> Finding:
100	        finding = Finding(self._module, severity, title, detail, **extra)
101	        finding.id = f"F{next(_finding_ids):03d}"
102	        finding.data = _jsonable(finding.data)
103	        self._case.findings.append(finding)
104	        self._emit({"type": "finding", "finding": asdict(finding)})
105	
106	        return finding
107	
108	    def artifact(
109	        self,
110	        name: str,
111	        kind: str,
112	        title: str,
113	        *,
114	        data: Any = None,
115	        file: str | None = None,
116	        time_s: float | None = None,
117	    ) -> Artifact:
118	        url = None
119	
120	        if file is not None:
121	            url = f"/api/cases/{self._case.id}/files/{os.path.relpath(file, self._case.workdir)}"
122	
123	        artifact = Artifact(
124	            self._module,
125	            name,
126	            kind,
127	            title,
128	            url=url,
129	            data=_jsonable(data),
130	            time_s=time_s,
131	            id=f"{self._module}:{name}",
132	        )
133	        self._case.artifacts[artifact.id] = artifact
134	        self._emit({"type": "artifact", "artifact": asdict(artifact)})
135	
136	        return artifact
137	
138	    def path(self, name: str) -> str:
139	        directory = os.path.join(self._case.workdir, self._module)
140	        os.makedirs(directory, exist_ok=True)
141	
142	        return os.path.join(directory, name)
143	
144	
145	class Module(Protocol):
146	    name: str
147	    title: str
148	    description: str
149	
150	    async def run(self, ctx: "CaseContext", out: Reporter) -> None: ...
151	
152	
153	class Skip(Exception):
154	    """Raised by a module that has nothing to work on (e.g. no audio)."""
155	
156	
157	@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
158	class VideoInfo:
159	    width: int
160	    height: int
161	    fps: float
162	    frame_count: int
163	    duration_s: float
164	    codec: str
165	    rotation: int
166	
167	
168	@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
169	class Frames:
170	    """Decoded frames at reduced size, RGB uint8, shape (n, h, w, 3)."""
171	
172	    pixels: np.ndarray
173	    times_s: np.ndarray
174	    fps: float
175	
176	
177	class CaseContext:
178	    """Everything modules share about one piece of evidence.
179	
180	    Expensive decodes are done once and cached; modules can also publish
181	    intermediate results for others with ``publish`` / ``wait_for``.
182	    """
183	
184	    def __init__(self, case_id: str, path: str, workdir: str, options: dict[str, Any]):
185	        self.id = case_id
186	        self.path = path
187	        self.workdir = workdir
188	        self.options = options
189	        self.findings: list[Finding] = []
190	        self.artifacts: dict[str, Artifact] = {}
191	        self._cache: dict[str, Any] = {}
192	        self._locks: dict[str, asyncio.Lock] = {}
193	        self._published: dict[str, Any] = {}
194	        self._events: dict[str, asyncio.Event] = {}
195	
196	    async def _cached[T](self, key: str, make: Callable[[], Awaitable[T]]) -> T:
197	        lock = self._locks.setdefault(key, asyncio.Lock())
198	
199	        async with lock:
200	            if key not in self._cache:
201	                self._cache[key] = await make()
202	
203	        return self._cache[key]
204	
205	    # ---- shared results between modules ---------------------------------
206	    def publish(self, key: str, value: Any) -> None:
207	        self._published[key] = value
208	        self._events.setdefault(key, asyncio.Event()).set()
209	
210	    async def wait_for(self, key: str, timeout: float = 600.0) -> Any:
211	        event = self._events.setdefault(key, asyncio.Event())
212	
213	        try:
214	            await asyncio.wait_for(event.wait(), timeout)
215	        except TimeoutError:
216	            return None
217	
218	        return self._published.get(key)
219	
220	    # ---- probing and decoding -------------------------------------------
221	    async def probe(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
222	        async def make() -> dict[str, Any]:
223	            output = await run_tool(
224	                "ffprobe",
225	                "-v",
226	                "error",
227	                "-print_format",
228	                "json",
229	                "-show_format",
230	                "-show_streams",
231	                self.path,
232	            )
233	
234	            return json.loads(output) if output else {}
235	
236	        return await self._cached("probe", make)
237	
238	    async def video_info(self) -> VideoInfo | None:
239	        async def make() -> VideoInfo | None:
240	            probe = await self.probe()
241	            stream = next(
242	                (
243	                    s
244	                    for s in probe.get("streams", [])
245	                    if s.get("codec_type") == "video"
246	                    and not s.get("disposition", {}).get("attached_pic")
247	                ),
248	                None,
249	            )
250	
251	            if stream is None:
252	                return None
253	
254	            fps = _rate(stream.get("avg_frame_rate")) or _rate(
255	                stream.get("r_frame_rate")
256	            )
257	            duration = float(
258	                stream.get("duration") or probe.get("format", {}).get("duration") or 0
259	            )
260	            frames = int(stream.get("nb_frames") or round(duration * (fps or 30)))
261	            rotation = 0
262	
263	            for side in stream.get("side_data_list", []):
264	                if "rotation" in side:
265	                    rotation = int(side["rotation"])
266	
267	            if "rotate" in stream.get("tags", {}):
268	                rotation = int(stream["tags"]["rotate"])
269	
270	            width, height = int(stream["width"]), int(stream["height"])
271	
272	            if abs(rotation) % 180 == 90:
273	                width, height = height, width
274	
275	            return VideoInfo(
276	                width=width,
277	                height=height,
278	                fps=fps or 30.0,
279	                frame_count=frames,
280	                duration_s=duration,
281	                codec=stream.get("codec_name", "?"),
282	                rotation=rotation,
283	            )
284	
285	        return await self._cached("video_info", make)
286	
287	    async def audio(self) -> media.Recording | None:
288	        async def make() -> media.Recording | None:
289	            recording = await media.load(self.path)
290	
291	            return None if isinstance(recording, ForensicError) else recording
292	
293	        return await self._cached("audio", make)
294	
295	    async def audio_native(self) -> tuple[np.ndarray, int] | None:
296	        """Mono audio at the file's own sample rate (for high-frequency work)."""
297	
298	        async def make() -> tuple[np.ndarray, int] | None:
299	            probe = await self.probe()
300	            stream = next(
301	                (s for s in probe.get("streams", []) if s.get("codec_type") == "audio"),
302	                None,
303	            )
304	
305	            if stream is None:
306	                return None
307	
308	            rate = int(stream.get("sample_rate") or 44_100)
309	            output = await run_tool(
310	                "ffmpeg", "-nostdin", "-v", "error", "-i", self.path, "-vn",
311	                "-ac", "1", "-ar", str(rate), "-f", "f32le", "-",
312	            )  # fmt: skip
313	
314	            if not output:
315	                return None
316	
317	            return np.frombuffer(output, dtype=np.float32).astype(np.float64), rate
318	
319	        return await self._cached("audio_native", make)
320	
321	    async def frames(self, width: int, *, max_frames: int = 9_000) -> Frames | None:
322	        """Every frame (up to max_frames) scaled to ``width`` pixels wide."""
323	
324	        async def make() -> Frames | None:
325	            info = await self.video_info()
326	
327	            if info is None:
328	                return None
329	
330	            height = max(2, int(round(width * info.height / info.width / 2)) * 2)
331	            args = ["ffmpeg", "-nostdin", "-v", "error", "-i", self.path]
332	            args += ["-frames:v", str(max_frames), "-vf", f"scale={width}:{height}"]
333	            args += [
334	                "-fps_mode",
335	                "passthrough",

337	                "rawvideo",
338	                "-pix_fmt",
339	                "rgb24",

341	            ]
342	            output = await run_tool(*args)
343	
344	            if not output:

346	
347	            pixels = np.frombuffer(output, dtype=np.uint8)

355	            )

357	            return Frames(pixels, times, info.fps)
358	
359	        return await self._cached(f"frames:{width}:{max_frames}", make)
360	
361	    async def frame_table(self) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
362	        """Per-frame packet facts: pts, type, size, key flag."""
363	
364	        async def make() -> list[dict[str, Any]]:

460	def _rate(text: str | None) -> float | None:
461	    if not text or text in ("0/0", "N/A"):
462	        return None
463	
464	    if "/" in text:
465	        numerator, denominator = text.split("/")
466	
467	        return float(numerator) / float(denominator) if float(denominator) else None
468	
469	    return float(text)

472	async def run_tool(*args: str, stdin: bytes | None = None) -> bytes | None:
473	    process = await asyncio.create_subprocess_exec(
474	        *args,
475	        stdin=subprocess.PIPE if stdin is not None else subprocess.DEVNULL,
476	        stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
477	        stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
478	    )
479	    stdout, _ = await process.communicate(stdin)
480	
481	    if process.returncode != 0:

487	def _jsonable(value: Any) -> Any:
488	    if isinstance(value, dict):
489	        return {str(k): _jsonable(v) for k, v in value.items()}
490	
491	    if isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):

"""Shared machinery for analysis modules.

A module is an object with a ``name``, a ``title`` and an async ``run(ctx, out)``.
It reports through ``out`` (a Reporter): progress, findings and artifacts. The
case runner turns those calls into JSON events that the web UI streams.
"""

import asyncio
import itertools
import json
import os
import subprocess
import time
from collections.abc import Awaitable
from collections.abc import Callable
from dataclasses import asdict
from dataclasses import dataclass
from dataclasses import field
from typing import Any
from typing import Literal
from typing import Protocol

import numpy as np

from earwitness import media
from earwitness._common import ForensicError

Severity = Literal["info", "notice", "warning", "critical"]
Kind = Literal["measured", "inferred"]

_finding_ids = itertools.count(1)


@dataclass(slots=True)
class Finding:
    module: str
    severity: Severity
    title: str
    detail: str
    time_s: float | None = None
    time_end_s: float | None = None
    kind: Kind = "measured"
    tags: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    data: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    id: str = ""


@dataclass(slots=True)
class Artifact:
    module: str
    name: str
    kind: str
    title: str
    url: str | None = None
    data: Any = None
    time_s: float | None = None
    id: str = ""


class Emit(Protocol):
    def __call__(self, event: dict[str, Any]) -> None: ...


class Reporter:
    """What a module uses to talk to the outside world."""

    def __init__(self, module: str, case: "CaseContext", emit: Emit) -> None:
        self._module = module
        self._case = case
        self._emit = emit
        self._last_progress = -1.0

    def progress(self, fraction: float, message: str = "") -> None:
        fraction = float(min(1.0, max(0.0, fraction)))

        if fraction - self._last_progress < 0.01 and not message:
            return

        self._last_progress = fraction
        self._emit(
            {
                "type": "module",
                "module": self._module,
                "status": "running",
                "progress": round(fraction, 3),
                "message": message,
            }
        )

    def log(self, message: str) -> None:
        self._emit({"type": "log", "module": self._module, "message": message})

    def finding(
        self,
        severity: Severity,
        title: str,
        detail: str,
        **extra: Any,
    ) -> Finding:
        finding = Finding(self._module, severity, title, detail, **extra)
        finding.id = f"F{next(_finding_ids):03d}"
        finding.data = _jsonable(finding.data)
        self._case.findings.append(finding)
        self._emit({"type": "finding", "finding": asdict(finding)})

        return finding

    def artifact(
        self,
        name: str,
        kind: str,
        title: str,
        *,
        data: Any = None,
        file: str | None = None,
        time_s: float | None = None,
    ) -> Artifact:
        url = None

        if file is not None:
            url = f"/api/cases/{self._case.id}/files/{os.path.relpath(file, self._case.workdir)}"

        artifact = Artifact(
            self._module,
            name,
            kind,
            title,
            url=url,
            data=_jsonable(data),
            time_s=time_s,
            id=f"{self._module}:{name}",
        )
        self._case.artifacts[artifact.id] = artifact
        self._emit({"type": "artifact", "artifact": asdict(artifact)})

        return artifact

    def path(self, name: str) -> str:
        directory = os.path.join(self._case.workdir, self._module)
        os.makedirs(directory, exist_ok=True)

        return os.path.join(directory, name)


class Module(Protocol):
    name: str
    title: str
    description: str

    async def run(self, ctx: "CaseContext", out: Reporter) -> None: ...


class Skip(Exception):
    """Raised by a module that has nothing to work on (e.g. no audio)."""


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class VideoInfo:
    width: int
    height: int
    fps: float
    frame_count: int
    duration_s: float
    codec: str
    rotation: int


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Frames:
    """Decoded frames at reduced size, RGB uint8, shape (n, h, w, 3)."""

    pixels: np.ndarray
    times_s: np.ndarray
    fps: float


class CaseContext:
    """Everything modules share about one piece of evidence.

    Expensive decodes are done once and cached; modules can also publish
    intermediate results for others with ``publish`` / ``wait_for``.
    """

    def __init__(self, case_id: str, path: str, workdir: str, options: dict[str, Any]):
        self.id = case_id
        self.path = path
        self.workdir = workdir
        self.options = options
        self.findings: list[Finding] = []
        self.artifacts: dict[str, Artifact] = {}
        self._cache: dict[str, Any] = {}
        self._locks: dict[str, asyncio.Lock] = {}
        self._published: dict[str, Any] = {}
        self._events: dict[str, asyncio.Event] = {}

    async def _cached[T](self, key: str, make: Callable[[], Awaitable[T]]) -> T:
        lock = self._locks.setdefault(key, asyncio.Lock())

        async with lock:
            if key not in self._cache:
                self._cache[key] = await make()

        return self._cache[key]

    # ---- shared results between modules ---------------------------------
    def publish(self, key: str, value: Any) -> None:
        self._published[key] = value
        self._events.setdefault(key, asyncio.Event()).set()

    async def wait_for(self, key: str, timeout: float = 600.0) -> Any:
        event = self._events.setdefault(key, asyncio.Event())

        try:
            await asyncio.wait_for(event.wait(), timeout)
        except TimeoutError:
            return None

        return self._published.get(key)

    # ---- probing and decoding -------------------------------------------
    async def probe(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        async def make() -> dict[str, Any]:
            output = await run_tool(
                "ffprobe",
                "-v",
                "error",
                "-print_format",
                "json",
                "-show_format",
                "-show_streams",
                self.path,
            )

            return json.loads(output) if output else {}

        return await self._cached("probe", make)

    async def video_info(self) -> VideoInfo | None:
        async def make() -> VideoInfo | None:
            probe = await self.probe()
            stream = next(
                (
                    s
                    for s in probe.get("streams", [])
                    if s.get("codec_type") == "video"
                    and not s.get("disposition", {}).get("attached_pic")
                ),
                None,
            )

            if stream is None:
                return None

            fps = _rate(stream.get("avg_frame_rate")) or _rate(
                stream.get("r_frame_rate")
            )
            duration = float(
                stream.get("duration") or probe.get("format", {}).get("duration") or 0
            )
            frames = int(stream.get("nb_frames") or round(duration * (fps or 30)))
            rotation = 0

            for side in stream.get("side_data_list", []):
                if "rotation" in side:
                    rotation = int(side["rotation"])

            if "rotate" in stream.get("tags", {}):
                rotation = int(stream["tags"]["rotate"])

            width, height = int(stream["width"]), int(stream["height"])

            if abs(rotation) % 180 == 90:
                width, height = height, width

            return VideoInfo(
                width=width,
                height=height,
                fps=fps or 30.0,
                frame_count=frames,
                duration_s=duration,
                codec=stream.get("codec_name", "?"),
                rotation=rotation,
            )

        return await self._cached("video_info", make)

    async def audio(self) -> media.Recording | None:
        async def make() -> media.Recording | None:
            recording = await media.load(self.path)

            return None if isinstance(recording, ForensicError) else recording

        return await self._cached("audio", make)

    async def audio_native(self) -> tuple[np.ndarray, int] | None:
        """Mono audio at the file's own sample rate (for high-frequency work)."""

        async def make() -> tuple[np.ndarray, int] | None:
            probe = await self.probe()
            stream = next(
                (s for s in probe.get("streams", []) if s.get("codec_type") == "audio"),
                None,
            )

            if stream is None:
                return None

            rate = int(stream.get("sample_rate") or 44_100)
            output = await run_tool(
                "ffmpeg", "-nostdin", "-v", "error", "-i", self.path, "-vn",
                "-ac", "1", "-ar", str(rate), "-f", "f32le", "-",
            )  # fmt: skip

            if not output:
                return None

            return np.frombuffer(output, dtype=np.float32).astype(np.float64), rate

        return await self._cached("audio_native", make)

    async def frames(self, width: int, *, max_frames: int = 9_000) -> Frames | None:
        """Every frame (up to max_frames) scaled to ``width`` pixels wide."""

        async def make() -> Frames | None:
            info = await self.video_info()

            if info is None:
                return None

            height = max(2, int(round(width * info.height / info.width / 2)) * 2)
            args = ["ffmpeg", "-nostdin", "-v", "error", "-i", self.path]
            args += ["-frames:v", str(max_frames), "-vf", f"scale={width}:{height}"]
            args += [
                "-fps_mode",
                "passthrough",
                "-f",
                "rawvideo",
                "-pix_fmt",
                "rgb24",
                "-",
            ]
            output = await run_tool(*args)

            if not output:
                return None

            pixels = np.frombuffer(output, dtype=np.uint8)
            count = len(pixels) // (width * height * 3)
            pixels = pixels[: count * width * height * 3].reshape(
                count, height, width, 3
            )
            times = await self.frame_times()
            times = (
                times[:count] if len(times) >= count else np.arange(count) / info.fps
            )

            return Frames(pixels, times, info.fps)

        return await self._cached(f"frames:{width}:{max_frames}", make)

    async def frame_table(self) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        """Per-frame packet facts: pts, type, size, key flag."""

        async def make() -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
            output = await run_tool(
                "ffprobe", "-v", "error", "-select_streams", "v:0",
                "-show_entries",
                "packet=pts_time,dts_time,size,flags,duration_time",
                "-of", "json", self.path,
            )  # fmt: skip

            if not output:
                return []

            packets = json.loads(output).get("packets", [])
            rows = []

            for packet in packets:
                if packet.get("pts_time") in (None, "N/A"):
                    continue

                rows.append(
                    {
                        "pts": float(packet["pts_time"]),
                        "size": int(packet.get("size", 0)),
                        "key": "K" in packet.get("flags", ""),
                    }
                )

            rows.sort(key=lambda r: r["pts"])

            return rows

        return await self._cached("frame_table", make)

    async def frame_times(self) -> np.ndarray:
        table = await self.frame_table()

        if not table:
            return np.array([])

        times = np.array([row["pts"] for row in table])

        return times - times[0]

    async def frame_at(
        self, time_s: float, *, width: int | None = None
    ) -> np.ndarray | None:
        """One full-resolution (or scaled) RGB frame at ``time_s``."""
        info = await self.video_info()

        if info is None:
            return None

        out_width = width or info.width
        out_height = max(2, int(round(out_width * info.height / info.width / 2)) * 2)
        output = await run_tool(
            "ffmpeg", "-nostdin", "-v", "error", "-ss", f"{max(0.0, time_s):.3f}",
            "-i", self.path, "-frames:v", "1",
            "-vf", f"scale={out_width}:{out_height}",
            "-f", "rawvideo", "-pix_fmt", "rgb24", "-",
        )  # fmt: skip

        if not output or len(output) < out_width * out_height * 3:
            return None

        return np.frombuffer(output, dtype=np.uint8)[
            : out_width * out_height * 3
        ].reshape(out_height, out_width, 3)

    async def clip_frames(
        self, start_s: float, count: int, *, width: int | None = None
    ) -> np.ndarray | None:
        """``count`` consecutive RGB frames starting at ``start_s``."""
        info = await self.video_info()

        if info is None:
            return None

        out_width = width or info.width
        out_height = max(2, int(round(out_width * info.height / info.width / 2)) * 2)
        output = await run_tool(
            "ffmpeg", "-nostdin", "-v", "error", "-ss", f"{max(0.0, start_s):.3f}",
            "-i", self.path, "-frames:v", str(count),
            "-vf", f"scale={out_width}:{out_height}",
            "-f", "rawvideo", "-pix_fmt", "rgb24", "-",
        )  # fmt: skip

        if not output:
            return None

        size = out_width * out_height * 3
        n = len(output) // size

        return np.frombuffer(output[: n * size], dtype=np.uint8).reshape(
            n, out_height, out_width, 3
        )


def _rate(text: str | None) -> float | None:
    if not text or text in ("0/0", "N/A"):
        return None

    if "/" in text:
        numerator, denominator = text.split("/")

        return float(numerator) / float(denominator) if float(denominator) else None

    return float(text)


async def run_tool(*args: str, stdin: bytes | None = None) -> bytes | None:
    process = await asyncio.create_subprocess_exec(
        *args,
        stdin=subprocess.PIPE if stdin is not None else subprocess.DEVNULL,
        stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
        stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
    )
    stdout, _ = await process.communicate(stdin)

    if process.returncode != 0:
        return None

    return stdout


def _jsonable(value: Any) -> Any:
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return {str(k): _jsonable(v) for k, v in value.items()}

    if isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
        return [_jsonable(v) for v in value]

    if isinstance(value, np.ndarray):
        return _jsonable(value.tolist())

    if isinstance(value, (np.floating, float)):
        f = float(value)

        return None if not np.isfinite(f) else round(f, 6)

    if isinstance(value, np.integer):
        return int(value)

    if isinstance(value, np.bool_):
        return bool(value)

    if hasattr(value, "isoformat"):
        return value.isoformat()

    return value


def downsample_series(
    x: np.ndarray, ys: dict[str, np.ndarray], max_points: int = 2_000
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """A compact {x, series} payload for the UI's charts."""
    x = np.asarray(x, dtype=float)
    step = max(1, int(np.ceil(len(x) / max_points)))

    return {
        "x": np.round(x[::step], 4),
        "series": [
            {"name": name, "y": np.round(np.asarray(y, dtype=float)[::step], 6)}
            for name, y in ys.items()
        ],
    }


def now() -> float:
    return time.time()

import asyncio
import json
import os
import re
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime
from datetime import timezone

import numpy as np

from earwitness._common import ForensicError
from earwitness._common import OnSuccess

ANALYSIS_SAMPLE_RATE = 16_000

_ISO6709 = re.compile(r"([+-]\d+(?:\.\d+)?)([+-]\d+(?:\.\d+)?)")
_FILENAME_TIME = re.compile(r"(20\d{6})[_-]?(\d{6})")
_LOCATION_TAGS = (
    "com.apple.quicktime.location.iso6709",
    "location",
    "location-eng",
)


class MediaError(ForensicError):
    PROBE_FAILED = "probe_failed"
    DECODE_FAILED = "decode_failed"
    NO_AUDIO = "no_audio"


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Coordinates:
    latitude: float
    longitude: float


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Metadata:
    """creation_time is whatever the container says; phones and Google Photos
    often store the end of recording rather than the start. filename_time is
    parsed from names like 20240722_131415 and is local time, zone unknown.
    """

    creation_time: datetime | None
    location: Coordinates | None
    duration_s: float
    filename_time: datetime | None


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class Recording:
    samples: np.ndarray
    sample_rate: int
    metadata: Metadata


async def _run(*args: str) -> bytes | None:
    process = await asyncio.create_subprocess_exec(
        *args,
        stdout=asyncio.subprocess.PIPE,
        stderr=asyncio.subprocess.PIPE,
    )
    stdout, _ = await process.communicate()

    if process.returncode != 0:
        return None

    return stdout


def _parse_time(value: str | None) -> datetime | None:
    if value is None:
        return None

    parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(value)

    if parsed.tzinfo is None:
        return parsed.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)

    return parsed.astimezone(timezone.utc)


def _parse_filename_time(path: str) -> datetime | None:
    found = _FILENAME_TIME.search(os.path.basename(path))

    if found is None:
        return None

    try:
        return datetime.strptime(found.group(1) + found.group(2), "%Y%m%d%H%M%S")
    # NOTE: strptime has no non-raising form; digits like 20241399 are invalid.
    except ValueError:
        return None


def _parse_location(tags: dict[str, str]) -> Coordinates | None:
    for key in _LOCATION_TAGS:
        value = tags.get(key)

        if value is None:
            continue

        found = _ISO6709.match(value)

        if found is not None:
            return Coordinates(float(found.group(1)), float(found.group(2)))

    return None


def _collect_tags(probe: dict[str, object]) -> dict[str, str]:
    tags: dict[str, str] = {}
    sections = [probe.get("format", {}), *probe.get("streams", [])]

    for section in sections:
        for key, value in section.get("tags", {}).items():
            tags.setdefault(key.lower(), value)

    return tags


async def probe(path: str) -> OnSuccess[Metadata]:
    output = await _run(
        "ffprobe",
        "-v",
        "error",
        "-print_format",
        "json",
        "-show_format",
        "-show_streams",
        path,
    )

    if output is None:
        return MediaError.PROBE_FAILED

    data = json.loads(output)

    if not any(s.get("codec_type") == "audio" for s in data.get("streams", [])):
        return MediaError.NO_AUDIO

    tags = _collect_tags(data)
    duration = float(data.get("format", {}).get("duration", 0.0))

    return Metadata(
        creation_time=_parse_time(tags.get("creation_time")),
        location=_parse_location(tags),
        duration_s=duration,
        filename_time=_parse_filename_time(path),
    )


async def load(path: str) -> OnSuccess[Recording]:
    metadata = await probe(path)

    if isinstance(metadata, ForensicError):
        return metadata

    output = await _run(
        "ffmpeg",
        "-nostdin",
        "-v",
        "error",
        "-i",
        path,
        "-vn",
        "-ac",
        "1",
        "-ar",
        str(ANALYSIS_SAMPLE_RATE),
        "-f",
        "f32le",
        "-",
    )

    if output is None or len(output) == 0:
        return MediaError.DECODE_FAILED

    samples = np.frombuffer(output, dtype=np.float32).astype(np.float64)

    return Recording(samples, ANALYSIS_SAMPLE_RATE, metadata)

"""The ordered list of analysis modules the case runner executes."""

import importlib
from typing import Any

_MODULES = [
    ("earwitness.modules.provenance", "Provenance"),
    ("earwitness.modules.timeline", "Timeline"),
    ("earwitness.modules.spectrum", "Spectrum"),
    ("earwitness.modules.enf", "Enf"),
    ("earwitness.modules.light", "Light"),
    ("earwitness.modules.pulse", "Pulse"),
    ("earwitness.modules.tamper", "Tamper"),
    ("earwitness.modules.avsync", "AvSync"),
    ("earwitness.modules.ocr", "Ocr"),
    ("earwitness.modules.transcript", "Transcript"),
    ("earwitness.modules.sounds", "Sounds"),
    ("earwitness.modules.vision", "Vision"),
    ("earwitness.modules.geo", "Geo"),
    ("earwitness.modules.weather", "Weather"),
    ("earwitness.modules.brief", "Brief"),
]


def all_modules() -> list[Any]:
    modules = []

    for path, cls in _MODULES:
        try:
            module = importlib.import_module(path)
        except ModuleNotFoundError as error:
            if error.name == path:
                continue

            raise

        modules.append(getattr(module, cls)())

    return modules

## REST

| Method | Path | Body / query | Returns |

| GET | `/api/health` | | `{ok, openai: bool, modules: [{name,title,description}]}` |
| GET | `/api/cases` | | `[CaseSummary]`, newest first (includes `verdict`, `summary_plain` once the brief exists) |

| GET | `/api/cases/{id}` | | `{summary: CaseSummary, events: [Event]}` (full replay) |
| DELETE | `/api/cases/{id}` | | `{deleted}` |

## WebSocket `/ws/cases/{id}`

On connect the server replays every event so far, then streams new ones live.

`container` {format_name, format_long_name, bit_rate, size_bytes, duration_s},

`{"type":"media","media_url":"/api/cases/…/files/proxy.mp4"}` (or `null` if transcoding failed; fall back to nothing).

{"type":"finding","finding":{
  "id":"F007","module":"spectrum","severity":"info|notice|warning|critical",

| `series` | `data {x:[…], series:[{name, y:[…], x?:[…]}], x_unit?, y_unit?, marks?:{label: x}}` or `{x_iso:[…], series}` (ISO time x-axis). A series with its own `x` overrides the shared x. `marks` = labelled vertical reference lines | line chart; if `x_unit=="s"` draw playhead |

| `text` | `data {text}` | prose panel |
| `json` | `data` = any JSON (e.g. `provenance:probe`, the raw ffprobe report) | collapsible tree |
| `brief` | `data {verdict: "EDITED"\|"POSSIBLY EDITED"\|"NO SIGNS OF EDITING", bullets:[str], text, corroborated:bool, headline?, narrative?, next_steps?:[str], model?}`. Bullets start with WHEN:/WHERE:/DEVICE:/PEOPLE:/INTEGRITY:/HIDDEN:/CORROBORATED: and cite finding ids like `[F012]` (make those clickable → scroll to/highlight the finding). `headline`/`narrative` exist only when OpenAI is on (AI-inferred) | the ANALYST/verdict panel (id `brief:brief`) |

1	"""Runs every module on one piece of evidence and fans events out to listeners."""
2	
3	import asyncio
4	import hashlib
5	import json
6	import os
7	import shutil
8	import time
9	import traceback
10	import uuid
11	from typing import Any
12	
13	import psycopg
14	
15	from earwitness import db
16	from earwitness.modules import registry
17	from earwitness.modules.base import CaseContext
18	from earwitness.modules.base import Reporter
19	from earwitness.modules.base import Skip
20	from earwitness.modules.base import run_tool
21	
22	
23	class Case:
24	    def __init__(
25	        self, case_id: str, workdir: str, filename: str, options: dict[str, Any]
26	    ):
27	        self.id = case_id
28	        self.workdir = workdir
29	        self.filename = filename
30	        self.options = options
31	        self.created = time.time()
32	        self.events: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
33	        self.listeners: set[asyncio.Queue[dict[str, Any]]] = set()
34	        self.status = "queued"
35	        self.ctx: CaseContext | None = None
36	        self.task: asyncio.Task[None] | None = None
37	        self._log = None
38	
39	    @property
40	    def evidence_path(self) -> str:
41	        return os.path.join(
42	            self.workdir, "evidence" + os.path.splitext(self.filename)[1].lower()
43	        )
44	
45	    def emit(self, event: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
46	        event = {"seq": len(self.events), "ts": round(time.time(), 3), **event}
47	        self.events.append(event)
48	
49	        if self._log is None:
50	            self._log = open(os.path.join(self.workdir, "events.jsonl"), "a")
51	
52	        self._log.write(json.dumps(event) + "\n")
53	        self._log.flush()
54	
55	        for queue in list(self.listeners):
56	            queue.put_nowait(event)
57	
58	    def summary(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
59	        case_event = next((e for e in self.events if e["type"] == "case"), None)
60	        findings = [e["finding"] for e in self.events if e["type"] == "finding"]
61	        brief = next(
62	            (
63	                e["artifact"]["data"]
64	                for e in reversed(self.events)
65	                if e["type"] == "artifact" and e["artifact"]["id"] == "brief:brief"
66	            ),
67	            {},
68	        )
69	
70	        return {
71	            "id": self.id,
72	            "filename": self.filename,
73	            "created": self.created,
74	            "status": self.status,
75	            "findings": len(findings),
76	            "warnings": sum(f["severity"] in ("warning", "critical") for f in findings),
77	            "case": case_event["case"] if case_event else None,
78	            "verdict": brief.get("verdict"),
79	            "summary_plain": brief.get("summary_plain"),
80	        }
81	
82	
83	class CaseStore:
84	    def __init__(self, root: str):
85	        self.root = root
86	        self.cases: dict[str, Case] = {}
87	        os.makedirs(root, exist_ok=True)
88	        self._load_existing()
89	
90	    def _load_existing(self) -> None:
91	        for case_id in sorted(os.listdir(self.root)):
92	            workdir = os.path.join(self.root, case_id)
93	            meta_path = os.path.join(workdir, "case.json")
94	
95	            if not os.path.isfile(meta_path):
96	                continue
97	
98	            with open(meta_path) as handle:
99	                meta = json.load(handle)
100	
101	            case = Case(case_id, workdir, meta["filename"], meta.get("options", {}))
102	            case.created = meta.get("created", case.created)
103	            events_path = os.path.join(workdir, "events.jsonl")
104	
105	            if os.path.isfile(events_path):
106	                with open(events_path) as handle:
107	                    case.events = [json.loads(line) for line in handle if line.strip()]
108	
109	            done = any(e["type"] == "done" for e in case.events)
110	            case.status = "done" if done else "interrupted"
111	            self.cases[case_id] = case
112	
113	    def create(self, filename: str, options: dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> Case:
114	        case_id = time.strftime("%Y%m%d-%H%M%S-") + uuid.uuid4().hex[:6]
115	        workdir = os.path.join(self.root, case_id)
116	        os.makedirs(workdir)
117	        case = Case(case_id, workdir, os.path.basename(filename), options or {})
118	
119	        with open(os.path.join(workdir, "case.json"), "w") as handle:
120	            json.dump(
121	                {
122	                    "filename": case.filename,
123	                    "created": case.created,
124	                    "options": case.options,
125	                },
126	                handle,
127	            )
128	
129	        self.cases[case_id] = case
130	
131	        return case
132	
133	    def delete(self, case_id: str) -> bool:
134	        case = self.cases.pop(case_id, None)
135	
136	        if case is None:
137	            return False
138	
139	        if case.task and not case.task.done():
140	            case.task.cancel()
141	
142	        shutil.rmtree(case.workdir, ignore_errors=True)
143	
144	        return True
145	
146	    async def sync_index(self) -> None:
147	        """Backfill the database index with every case on disk."""
148	        for case in list(self.cases.values()):
149	            await db.index_case(case)
150	
151	    def start(self, case: Case, *, only: list[str] | None = None) -> None:
152	        case.task = asyncio.create_task(run_case(case, only=only))
153	
154	
155	async def _make_proxy(case: Case) -> str | None:
156	    """An H.264 copy every browser can play (phones record HEVC/VP9)."""
157	    out = os.path.join(case.workdir, "proxy.mp4")
158	
159	    if os.path.isfile(out):
160	        return out
161	
162	    result = await run_tool(
163	        "ffmpeg", "-nostdin", "-v", "error", "-y", "-i", case.evidence_path,
164	        "-map", "0:v:0?", "-map", "0:a:0?",
165	        "-vf", "scale='min(1280,iw)':-2",
166	        "-c:v", "libx264", "-preset", "veryfast", "-crf", "23", "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p",
167	        "-c:a", "aac", "-b:a", "128k", "-movflags", "+faststart", out,
168	    )  # fmt: skip
169	
170	    return out if result is not None and os.path.isfile(out) else None
171	
172	
173	async def _thumbnail(case: Case) -> None:
174	    await run_tool(
175	        "ffmpeg", "-nostdin", "-v", "error", "-y", "-ss", "0.5", "-i", case.evidence_path,
176	        "-frames:v", "1", "-vf", "scale=320:-2,format=yuvj420p", os.path.join(case.workdir, "thumb.jpg"),
177	    )  # fmt: skip
178	
179	
180	def _hash_file(path: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
181	    sha, md5 = hashlib.sha256(), hashlib.md5()
182	
183	    with open(path, "rb") as handle:
184	        while chunk := handle.read(1 << 20):
185	            sha.update(chunk)
186	            md5.update(chunk)
187	
188	    return sha.hexdigest(), md5.hexdigest()
189	
190	
191	def _fps(text: str | None) -> float | None:
192	    if not text or text in ("0/0", "N/A"):
193	        return None
194	
195	    num, _, den = text.partition("/")
196	
197	    return round(float(num) / float(den), 3) if den and float(den) else float(num)
198	
199	
200	def _num(value: Any) -> float | None:
201	    try:
202	        return float(value)
203	    except TypeError, ValueError:
204	        return None
205

207	async def _custody(case: "Case", probe: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
208	    """Chain-of-custody facts: hashes, container, every stream, every tag."""
209	    sha256, md5 = await asyncio.to_thread(_hash_file, case.evidence_path)
210	    fmt = probe.get("format", {})
211	    tags: dict[str, str] = {}
212	
213	    for key, value in fmt.get("tags", {}).items():
214	        tags[key] = str(value)
215	
216	    for stream in probe.get("streams", []):
217	        for key, value in stream.get("tags", {}).items():
218	            tags.setdefault(f"stream{stream.get('index')}.{key}", str(value))
219	
220	    streams = [
221	        {
222	            "index": s.get("index"),
223	            "type": s.get("codec_type"),
224	            "codec": s.get("codec_name"),
225	            "codec_long": s.get("codec_long_name"),
226	            "profile": s.get("profile"),
227	            "width": s.get("width"),
228	            "height": s.get("height"),
229	            "fps": _fps(s.get("avg_frame_rate"))
230	            if s.get("codec_type") == "video"
231	            else None,
232	            "pix_fmt": s.get("pix_fmt"),
233	            "color_range": s.get("color_range"),
234	            "color_space": s.get("color_space"),
235	            "bit_rate": _num(s.get("bit_rate")),
236	            "sample_rate": _num(s.get("sample_rate")),
237	            "channels": s.get("channels"),
238	            "channel_layout": s.get("channel_layout"),
239	            "language": s.get("tags", {}).get("language"),
240	            "handler": s.get("tags", {}).get("handler_name"),
241	            "duration_s": _num(s.get("duration")),
242	            "frames": _num(s.get("nb_frames")),
243	        }
244	        for s in probe.get("streams", [])
245	    ]
246	
247	    return {
248	        "sha256": sha256,
249	        "md5": md5,
250	        "ingested_at": case.created,
251	        "container": {
252	            "format_name": fmt.get("format_name"),
253	            "format_long_name": fmt.get("format_long_name"),
254	            "bit_rate": _num(fmt.get("bit_rate")),
255	            "size_bytes": _num(fmt.get("size")),
256	            "duration_s": _num(fmt.get("duration")),
257	        },
258	        "streams": streams,
259	        "tags": tags,
260	    }
261

263	async def _index(case: Case) -> None:
264	    # The files are the record of the run; a database hiccup must not sink it.
265	    try:
266	        await db.index_case(case)
267	    except (psycopg.Error, OSError) as error:
268	        case.emit(
269	            {"type": "log", "module": "index",
270	             "message": f"database index not updated: {type(error).__name__}: {error}"}
271	        )  # fmt: skip
272	
273	
274	async def run_case(case: Case, *, only: list[str] | None = None) -> None:
275	    case.status = "running"
276	    # Mark the case running in the index without holding up the analysis.
277	    started_index = asyncio.create_task(_index(case))
278	    ctx = CaseContext(case.id, case.evidence_path, case.workdir, case.options)
279	    case.ctx = ctx
280	    probe = await ctx.probe()
281	    info = await ctx.video_info()
282	    has_audio = any(s.get("codec_type") == "audio" for s in probe.get("streams", []))
283	    modules = [m for m in registry.all_modules() if only is None or m.name in only]
284	
285	    # Modules not scheduled in this run count as finished with nothing to say,
286	    # so anything waiting on them carries on immediately.
287	    for other in registry.all_modules():
288	        if other.name not in {m.name for m in modules}:
289	            ctx.publish(other.name, None)
290	    proxy_task = asyncio.create_task(_make_proxy(case))
291	    await _thumbnail(case)
292	    case.emit(
293	        {
294	            "type": "case",
295	            "case": {
296	                "id": case.id,
297	                "filename": case.filename,
298	                "duration_s": float(probe.get("format", {}).get("duration") or 0),
299	                "size_bytes": int(probe.get("format", {}).get("size") or 0),
300	                "has_audio": has_audio,
301	                "video": None
302	                if info is None
303	                else {
304	                    "width": info.width,
305	                    "height": info.height,
306	                    "fps": round(info.fps, 3),
307	                    "codec": info.codec,
308	                    "frames": info.frame_count,
309	                },
310	                "thumb_url": f"/api/cases/{case.id}/files/thumb.jpg",
311	                "media_url": None,
312	                **(await _custody(case, probe)),
313	                "modules": [
314	                    {"name": m.name, "title": m.title, "description": m.description}
315	                    for m in modules
316	                ],
317	            },
318	        }
319	    )
320	
321	    for module in modules:
322	        case.emit(
323	            {"type": "module", "module": module.name, "status": "queued", "progress": 0}
324	        )
325	
326	    # Heavy modules are numpy/OpenCV bound; a small limit keeps the UI lively.
327	    gate = asyncio.Semaphore(int(os.environ.get("EARWITNESS_PARALLEL", "4")))
328	
329	    async def one(module: Any) -> None:
330	        reporter = Reporter(module.name, ctx, case.emit)
331	        depends = list(getattr(module, "depends", ()))
332	
333	        if depends == ["*"]:
334	            depends = [m.name for m in modules if m.name != module.name]
335	
336	        if depends:
337	            case.emit(
338	                {"type": "module", "module": module.name, "status": "waiting",
339	                 "progress": 0, "message": "waiting for " + ", ".join(depends)}
340	            )  # fmt: skip
341	
342	        for dependency in depends:
343	            if any(m.name == dependency for m in modules):
344	                await ctx.wait_for(dependency)
345	
346	        started = time.time()
347	
348	        async with gate:
349	            case.emit(
350	                {
351	                    "type": "module",
352	                    "module": module.name,
353	                    "status": "running",
354	                    "progress": 0,
355	                }
356	            )
357	
358	            try:
359	                await module.run(ctx, reporter)
360	            except Skip as reason:
361	                ctx.publish(module.name, None)
362	                case.emit(
363	                    {"type": "module", "module": module.name, "status": "skipped",
364	                     "progress": 1, "message": str(reason)}
365	                )  # fmt: skip
366	
367	                return
368	            except asyncio.CancelledError:
369	                raise
370	            except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001 - one module must not sink the case
371	                ctx.publish(module.name, None)
372	                case.emit(
373	                    {"type": "module", "module": module.name, "status": "error",
374	                     "progress": 1, "message": f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}",
375	                     "trace": traceback.format_exc()[-2000:]}
376	                )  # fmt: skip
377	
378	                return
379	
380	        if module.name not in ctx._published:
381	            ctx.publish(module.name, None)
382	
383	        case.emit(
384	            {"type": "module", "module": module.name, "status": "done", "progress": 1,
385	             "elapsed_s": round(time.time() - started, 2)}
386	        )  # fmt: skip
387	
388	    async def proxy() -> None:
389	        path = await proxy_task
390	        case.emit(
391	            {
392	                "type": "media",
393	                "media_url": f"/api/cases/{case.id}/files/proxy.mp4" if path else None,
394	            }
395	        )
396	
397	    await asyncio.gather(proxy(), *(one(m) for m in modules))
398	    case.status = "done"
399	    await started_index
400	    await _index(case)
401	    case.emit({"type": "done"})

64	class Reporter:
65	    """What a module uses to talk to the outside world."""
66	
67	    def __init__(self, module: str, case: "CaseContext", emit: Emit) -> None:
68	        self._module = module
69	        self._case = case
70	        self._emit = emit
71	        self._last_progress = -1.0

73	    def progress(self, fraction: float, message: str = "") -> None:
74	        fraction = float(min(1.0, max(0.0, fraction)))
75	
76	        if fraction - self._last_progress < 0.01 and not message:
77	            return
78	
79	        self._last_progress = fraction
80	        self._emit(
81	            {
82	                "type": "module",
83	                "module": self._module,
84	                "status": "running",
85	                "progress": round(fraction, 3),
86	                "message": message,
87	            }
88	        )

90	    def log(self, message: str) -> None:
91	        self._emit({"type": "log", "module": self._module, "message": message})

93	    def finding(
94	        self,
95	        severity: Severity,
96	        title: str,
97	        detail: str,
98	        **extra: Any,
99	    ) -> Finding:
100	        finding = Finding(self._module, severity, title, detail, **extra)
101	        finding.id = f"F{next(_finding_ids):03d}"
102	        finding.data = _jsonable(finding.data)
103	        self._case.findings.append(finding)
104	        self._emit({"type": "finding", "finding": asdict(finding)})

177	class CaseContext:
178	    """Everything modules share about one piece of evidence.
179	
180	    Expensive decodes are done once and cached; modules can also publish
181	    intermediate results for others with ``publish`` / ``wait_for``.
182	    """
183	
184	    def __init__(self, case_id: str, path: str, workdir: str, options: dict[str, Any]):
185	        self.id = case_id
186	        self.path = path
187	        self.workdir = workdir
188	        self.options = options
189	        self.findings: list[Finding] = []
190	        self.artifacts: dict[str, Artifact] = {}
191	        self._cache: dict[str, Any] = {}
192	        self._locks: dict[str, asyncio.Lock] = {}
193	        self._published: dict[str, Any] = {}
194	        self._events: dict[str, asyncio.Event] = {}
195	
196	    async def _cached[T](self, key: str, make: Callable[[], Awaitable[T]]) -> T:
197	        lock = self._locks.setdefault(key, asyncio.Lock())
198	
199	        async with lock:
200	            if key not in self._cache:
201	                self._cache[key] = await make()
202	
203	        return self._cache[key]
204	
205	    # ---- shared results between modules ---------------------------------
206	    def publish(self, key: str, value: Any) -> None:
207	        self._published[key] = value
208	        self._events.setdefault(key, asyncio.Event()).set()
209	
210	    async def wait_for(self, key: str, timeout: float = 600.0) -> Any:
211	        event = self._events.setdefault(key, asyncio.Event())
212	
213	        try:
214	            await asyncio.wait_for(event.wait(), timeout)
215	        except TimeoutError:
216	            return None
217	
218	        return self._published.get(key)
219	
220	    # ---- probing and decoding -------------------------------------------
221	    async def probe(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
222	        async def make() -> dict[str, Any]:
223	            output = await run_tool(
224	                "ffprobe",
225	                "-v",
226	                "error",
227	                "-print_format",
228	                "json",
229	                "-show_format",
230	                "-show_streams",
231	                self.path,
232	            )
233	
234	            return json.loads(output) if output else {}
235	
236	        return await self._cached("probe", make)
237	
238	    async def video_info(self) -> VideoInfo | None:
239	        async def make() -> VideoInfo | None:
240	            probe = await self.probe()
241	            stream = next(
242	                (
243	                    s
244	                    for s in probe.get("streams", [])
245	                    if s.get("codec_type") == "video"
246	                    and not s.get("disposition", {}).get("attached_pic")
247	                ),
248	                None,
249	            )
250	
251	            if stream is None:
252	                return None
253	
254	            fps = _rate(stream.get("avg_frame_rate")) or _rate(
255	                stream.get("r_frame_rate")
256	            )
257	            duration = float(
258	                stream.get("duration") or probe.get("format", {}).get("duration") or 0
259	            )
260	            frames = int(stream.get("nb_frames") or round(duration * (fps or 30)))
261	            rotation = 0
262	
263	            for side in stream.get("side_data_list", []):
264	                if "rotation" in side:
265	                    rotation = int(side["rotation"])
266	
267	            if "rotate" in stream.get("tags", {}):
268	                rotation = int(stream["tags"]["rotate"])
269	
270	            width, height = int(stream["width"]), int(stream["height"])
271	
272	            if abs(rotation) % 180 == 90:
273	                width, height = height, width
274	
275	            return VideoInfo(
276	                width=width,
277	                height=height,
278	                fps=fps or 30.0,
279	                frame_count=frames,
280	                duration_s=duration,
281	                codec=stream.get("codec_name", "?"),
282	                rotation=rotation,
283	            )
284	
285	        return await self._cached("video_info", make)
286	
287	    async def audio(self) -> media.Recording | None:
288	        async def make() -> media.Recording | None:
289	            recording = await media.load(self.path)
290	
291	            return None if isinstance(recording, ForensicError) else recording
292	
293	        return await self._cached("audio", make)

295	    async def audio_native(self) -> tuple[np.ndarray, int] | None:
296	        """Mono audio at the file's own sample rate (for high-frequency work)."""
297	
298	        async def make() -> tuple[np.ndarray, int] | None:
299	            probe = await self.probe()
300	            stream = next(
301	                (s for s in probe.get("streams", []) if s.get("codec_type") == "audio"),
302	                None,
303	            )
304	
305	            if stream is None:
306	                return None
307	
308	            rate = int(stream.get("sample_rate") or 44_100)
309	            output = await run_tool(
310	                "ffmpeg", "-nostdin", "-v", "error", "-i", self.path, "-vn",
311	                "-ac", "1", "-ar", str(rate), "-f", "f32le", "-",
312	            )  # fmt: skip
313	
314	            if not output:
315	                return None
316	
317	            return np.frombuffer(output, dtype=np.float32).astype(np.float64), rate
318	
319	        return await self._cached("audio_native", make)
320	
321	    async def frames(self, width: int, *, max_frames: int = 9_000) -> Frames | None:
322	        """Every frame (up to max_frames) scaled to ``width`` pixels wide."""
323	
324	        async def make() -> Frames | None:
325	            info = await self.video_info()
326	
327	            if info is None:
328	                return None
329	
330	            height = max(2, int(round(width * info.height / info.width / 2)) * 2)
331	            args = ["ffmpeg", "-nostdin", "-v", "error", "-i", self.path]
332	            args += ["-frames:v", str(max_frames), "-vf", f"scale={width}:{height}"]
333	            args += [
334	                "-fps_mode",
335	                "passthrough",
336	                "-f",
337	                "rawvideo",
338	                "-pix_fmt",
339	                "rgb24",
340	                "-",
341	            ]
342	            output = await run_tool(*args)
343	
344	            if not output:
345	                return None
346	
347	            pixels = np.frombuffer(output, dtype=np.uint8)
348	            count = len(pixels) // (width * height * 3)
349	            pixels = pixels[: count * width * height * 3].reshape(
350	                count, height, width, 3
351	            )
352	            times = await self.frame_times()
353	            times = (
354	                times[:count] if len(times) >= count else np.arange(count) / info.fps
355	            )
356	
357	            return Frames(pixels, times, info.fps)
358	
359	        return await self._cached(f"frames:{width}:{max_frames}", make)
360	
361	    async def frame_table(self) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
362	        """Per-frame packet facts: pts, type, size, key flag."""
363	
364	        async def make() -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
365	            output = await run_tool(
366	                "ffprobe", "-v", "error", "-select_streams", "v:0",
367	                "-show_entries",
368	                "packet=pts_time,dts_time,size,flags,duration_time",
369	                "-of", "json", self.path,
370	            )  # fmt: skip
371	
372	            if not output:
373	                return []
374	
375	            packets = json.loads(output).get("packets", [])
376	            rows = []
377	
378	            for packet in packets:
379	                if packet.get("pts_time") in (None, "N/A"):
380	                    continue
381	
382	                rows.append(
383	                    {
384	                        "pts": float(packet["pts_time"]),
385	                        "size": int(packet.get("size", 0)),
386	                        "key": "K" in packet.get("flags", ""),
387	                    }
388	                )
389	
390	            rows.sort(key=lambda r: r["pts"])
391	
392	            return rows
393	
394	        return await self._cached("frame_table", make)
395	
396	    async def frame_times(self) -> np.ndarray:
397	        table = await self.frame_table()
398	
399	        if not table:
400	            return np.array([])
401	
402	        times = np.array([row["pts"] for row in table])
403	
404	        return times - times[0]
405	
406	    async def frame_at(
407	        self, time_s: float, *, width: int | None = None
408	    ) -> np.ndarray | None:
409	        """One full-resolution (or scaled) RGB frame at ``time_s``."""
410	        info = await self.video_info()
411	
412	        if info is None:
413	            return None
414	
415	        out_width = width or info.width
416	        out_height = max(2, int(round(out_width * info.height / info.width / 2)) * 2)
417	        output = await run_tool(
418	            "ffmpeg", "-nostdin", "-v", "error", "-ss", f"{max(0.0, time_s):.3f}",
419	            "-i", self.path, "-frames:v", "1",
420	            "-vf", f"scale={out_width}:{out_height}",
421	            "-f", "rawvideo", "-pix_fmt", "rgb24", "-",
422	        )  # fmt: skip
423	
424	        if not output or len(output) < out_width * out_height * 3:
425	            return None
426	
427	        return np.frombuffer(output, dtype=np.uint8)[
428	            : out_width * out_height * 3
429	        ].reshape(out_height, out_width, 3)
430	
431	    async def clip_frames(
432	        self, start_s: float, count: int, *, width: int | None = None
433	    ) -> np.ndarray | None:
434	        """``count`` consecutive RGB frames starting at ``start_s``."""
435	        info = await self.video_info()
436	
437	        if info is None:
438	            return None
439	
440	        out_width = width or info.width
441	        out_height = max(2, int(round(out_width * info.height / info.width / 2)) * 2)
442	        output = await run_tool(
443	            "ffmpeg", "-nostdin", "-v", "error", "-ss", f"{max(0.0, start_s):.3f}",
444	            "-i", self.path, "-frames:v", str(count),
445	            "-vf", f"scale={out_width}:{out_height}",
446	            "-f", "rawvideo", "-pix_fmt", "rgb24", "-",
447	        )  # fmt: skip
448	
449	        if not output:
450	            return None
451	
452	        size = out_width * out_height * 3
453	        n = len(output) // size
454	
455	        return np.frombuffer(output[: n * size], dtype=np.uint8).reshape(
456	            n, out_height, out_width, 3
457	        )

460	def _rate(text: str | None) -> float | None:
461	    if not text or text in ("0/0", "N/A"):
462	        return None
463	
464	    if "/" in text:
465	        numerator, denominator = text.split("/")
466	
467	        return float(numerator) / float(denominator) if float(denominator) else None
468	
469	    return float(text)
470

472	async def run_tool(*args: str, stdin: bytes | None = None) -> bytes | None:
473	    process = await asyncio.create_subprocess_exec(
474	        *args,
475	        stdin=subprocess.PIPE if stdin is not None else subprocess.DEVNULL,
476	        stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
477	        stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
478	    )
479	    stdout, _ = await process.communicate(stdin)
480	
481	    if process.returncode != 0:
482	        return None
483	
484	    return stdout

487	def _jsonable(value: Any) -> Any:
488	    if isinstance(value, dict):
489	        return {str(k): _jsonable(v) for k, v in value.items()}
490	
491	    if isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
492	        return [_jsonable(v) for v in value]
493	
494	    if isinstance(value, np.ndarray):
495	        return _jsonable(value.tolist())
496	
497	    if isinstance(value, (np.floating, float)):
498	        f = float(value)
499	
500	        return None if not np.isfinite(f) else round(f, 6)
501	
502	    if isinstance(value, np.integer):
503	        return int(value)
504	
505	    if isinstance(value, np.bool_):
506	        return bool(value)
507	
508	    if hasattr(value, "isoformat"):
509	        return value.isoformat()
510	
511	    return value

514	def downsample_series(
515	    x: np.ndarray, ys: dict[str, np.ndarray], max_points: int = 2_000
516	) -> dict[str, Any]:
517	    """A compact {x, series} payload for the UI's charts."""
518	    x = np.asarray(x, dtype=float)
519	    step = max(1, int(np.ceil(len(x) / max_points)))
520	
521	    return {
522	        "x": np.round(x[::step], 4),
523	        "series": [
524	            {"name": name, "y": np.round(np.asarray(y, dtype=float)[::step], 6)}
525	            for name, y in ys.items()
526	        ],
527	    }

75	    parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(value)

77	    if parsed.tzinfo is None:

89	    try:
90	        return datetime.strptime(found.group(1) + found.group(2), "%Y%m%d%H%M%S")

137	    data = json.loads(output)
138	
139	    if not any(s.get("codec_type") == "audio" for s in data.get("streams", [])):
140	        return MediaError.NO_AUDIO
141	
142	    tags = _collect_tags(data)
143	    duration = float(data.get("format", {}).get("duration", 0.0))
144	
145	    return Metadata(
146	        creation_time=_parse_time(tags.get("creation_time")),
147	        location=_parse_location(tags),
148	        duration_s=duration,
149	        filename_time=_parse_filename_time(path),
150	    )
151	
152	
153	async def load(path: str) -> OnSuccess[Recording]:
154	    metadata = await probe(path)
155	
156	    if isinstance(metadata, ForensicError):
157	        return metadata
158	
159	    output = await _run(
160	        "ffmpeg",
161	        "-nostdin",
162	        "-v",
163	        "error",
164	        "-i",
165	        path,
166	        "-vn",
167	        "-ac",
168	        "1",
169	        "-ar",
170	        str(ANALYSIS_SAMPLE_RATE),
171	        "-f",
172	        "f32le",
173	        "-",
174	    )
175	
176	    if output is None or len(output) == 0:
177	        return MediaError.DECODE_FAILED
178	
179	    samples = np.frombuffer(output, dtype=np.float32).astype(np.float64)
180	
181	    return Recording(samples, ANALYSIS_SAMPLE_RATE, metadata)

1	# EARWITNESS server ↔ UI protocol
2	
3	Backend: FastAPI (`uv run earwitness serve --port 8765`). In production the
4	built SPA (`web/dist`) is served by the same server at `/`. In dev, Vite proxies
5	`/api` and `/ws` to `http://127.0.0.1:8765`.
6	
7	## REST
8	
9	| Method | Path | Body / query | Returns |
10	|---|---|---|---|
11	| GET | `/api/health` | | `{ok, openai: bool, modules: [{name,title,description}]}` |
12	| GET | `/api/cases` | | `[CaseSummary]`, newest first (includes `verdict`, `summary_plain` once the brief exists) |
13	| POST | `/api/cases` | multipart `file`; optional query `approx_time` (ISO), `search_hours` | `CaseSummary` (analysis starts immediately) |
14	| POST | `/api/cases/from-path` | JSON `{path, options?}` (a file on the server machine) | `CaseSummary` |
15	| GET | `/api/cases/{id}` | | `{summary: CaseSummary, events: [Event]}` (full replay) |
16	| DELETE | `/api/cases/{id}` | | `{deleted}` |
17	| POST | `/api/cases/{id}/rerun` | | `CaseSummary` |
18	| GET | `/api/cases/{id}/files/{path}` | | artifact files (PNG/JPG/MP4); URLs arrive ready-made in events |
19	| POST | `/api/cases/{id}/enhance` | JSON `{time_s, x, y, w, h, frames?}`; x,y,w,h are 0..1 fractions of the video frame | `{single_url, enhanced_url, frames_used, scale, source_px:[w,h], time_s}` |
20	| GET | `/api/cases/{id}/report` | | printable HTML report (open in new tab) |
21	
22	`CaseSummary = {id, filename, created (unix s), status: queued|running|done|interrupted, findings, warnings, case: CaseInfo|null}`
23	
24	## WebSocket `/ws/cases/{id}`
25	
26	On connect the server replays every event so far, then streams new ones live.
27	Every event has `seq` (0-based, increasing) and `ts` (unix seconds) plus a `type`:
28	
29	### `case` (first event)
30	```json
31	{"type":"case","case":{"id":"…","filename":"IMG_6335.MOV","duration_s":23.1,"size_bytes":27607625,
32	 "has_audio":true,"video":{"width":1080,"height":1920,"fps":30.0,"codec":"hevc","frames":693}|null,
33	 "thumb_url":"/api/cases/…/files/thumb.jpg","media_url":null,
34	 "modules":[{"name":"provenance","title":"PROVENANCE","description":"…"}, …]}}
35	```
36	
37	Since the custody update, `case` also carries `sha256`, `md5`, `ingested_at` (unix s),
38	`container` {format_name, format_long_name, bit_rate, size_bytes, duration_s},
39	`streams` [{index, type, codec, codec_long, profile, width, height, fps, pix_fmt,
40	color_range, color_space, bit_rate, sample_rate, channels, channel_layout, language,
41	handler, duration_s, frames}] and `tags` (every container tag, plus stream tags as
42	`stream<N>.<key>`).
43	
44	### `media`
45	Browser-playable H.264 proxy of the evidence is ready (phones record HEVC/VP9):
46	`{"type":"media","media_url":"/api/cases/…/files/proxy.mp4"}` (or `null` if transcoding failed; fall back to nothing).
47	
48	### `module`, status updates per analysis module
49	`{"type":"module","module":"timeline","status":"queued|waiting|running|done|skipped|error","progress":0..1,"message":"decoding frames","elapsed_s"?:1.2,"trace"?:"…"}`
50	
51	### `finding`, the main payload
52	```json
53	{"type":"finding","finding":{
54	  "id":"F007","module":"spectrum","severity":"info|notice|warning|critical",
55	  "title":"Keypad tones decoded: 1984#","detail":"…one or two sentences…",
56	  "time_s":4.0|null,"time_end_s":null,
57	  "kind":"measured|inferred",          // inferred = AI (OpenAI) output, label it so
58	  "tags":["dtmf","audio"],              // e.g. splice, cut, location, gps, time, tone, ultrasonic, enf, face, pulse, text …
59	  "data":{…module-specific…}}}
60	```
61	Clicking a finding with `time_s` should seek the video there. Findings tagged
62	`location`/`gps` usually carry `data.lat/lon`.
63	
64	### `artifact`, things to visualise
65	`{"type":"artifact","artifact":{"id":"module:name","module":"…","name":"…","kind":"…","title":"…","url":string|null,"data":any,"time_s":number|null}}`
66	
67	An artifact with an id already seen replaces the old one. Kinds:
68	
69	| kind | payload | render as |
70	|---|---|---|
71	| `spectrogram` | `url` PNG (low freq at bottom); `data {t0,t1,f0,f1,scale:"linear"}` | image with time/freq axes; draw a playhead synced to the video |
72	| `series` | `data {x:[…], series:[{name, y:[…], x?:[…]}], x_unit?, y_unit?, marks?:{label: x}}` or `{x_iso:[…], series}` (ISO time x-axis). A series with its own `x` overrides the shared x. `marks` = labelled vertical reference lines | line chart; if `x_unit=="s"` draw playhead |
73	| `waveform` | `data {t1, peak:[0..1 …]}` | mirrored waveform strip on the timeline |
74	| `filmstrip` | `url` JPG sprite: `count` tiles side-by-side; `data {tile_width,tile_height,times:[…],count}` | thumbnail track on the timeline |
75	| `markers` | `data {times:[…], …}` | tick marks on the timeline |
76	| `table` | `data {rows:[[…]], columns?:[…]}` | monospace table |
77	| `bars` | `data {labels:[…], values:[…]}` | bar chart |
78	| `map` | `data {points:[{lat,lon,label,accuracy_m?,kind}]}` | dark map (Leaflet + CARTO dark tiles), accuracy circle |
79	| `image` / `heatmap` | `url`, optional `data {caption, time_s, overlay?:bool}` | gallery; heatmaps can overlay the video at `time_s` |
80	| `video` | `url` MP4 (e.g. pulse colour magnification) | player |
81	| `text` | `data {text}` | prose panel |
82	| `json` | `data` = any JSON (e.g. `provenance:probe`, the raw ffprobe report) | collapsible tree |
83	| `brief` | `data {verdict: "EDITED"\|"POSSIBLY EDITED"\|"NO SIGNS OF EDITING", bullets:[str], text, corroborated:bool, headline?, narrative?, next_steps?:[str], model?}`. Bullets start with WHEN:/WHERE:/DEVICE:/PEOPLE:/INTEGRITY:/HIDDEN:/CORROBORATED: and cite finding ids like `[F012]` (make those clickable → scroll to/highlight the finding). `headline`/`narrative` exist only when OpenAI is on (AI-inferred) | the ANALYST/verdict panel (id `brief:brief`) |
84	| `captions` | `data {segments:[{start,end,text}]}` | subtitles over the video at currentTime + transcript list |
85	
86	### `log`
87	`{"type":"log","module":"…","message":"…"}`, for a scrolling terminal feed.
88	
89	### `done`
90	All modules finished.

23	class Case:
24	    def __init__(
25	        self, case_id: str, workdir: str, filename: str, options: dict[str, Any]
26	    ):
27	        self.id = case_id
28	        self.workdir = workdir
29	        self.filename = filename
30	        self.options = options
31	        self.created = time.time()
32	        self.events: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
33	        self.listeners: set[asyncio.Queue[dict[str, Any]]] = set()
34	        self.status = "queued"
35	        self.ctx: CaseContext | None = None
36	        self.task: asyncio.Task[None] | None = None
37	        self._log = None
38	
39	    @property
40	    def evidence_path(self) -> str:
41	        return os.path.join(
42	            self.workdir, "evidence" + os.path.splitext(self.filename)[1].lower()
43	        )
44	
45	    def emit(self, event: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
46	        event = {"seq": len(self.events), "ts": round(time.time(), 3), **event}
47	        self.events.append(event)
48	
49	        if self._log is None:
50	            self._log = open(os.path.join(self.workdir, "events.jsonl"), "a")
51	
52	        self._log.write(json.dumps(event) + "\n")
53	        self._log.flush()
54	
55	        for queue in list(self.listeners):
56	            queue.put_nowait(event)
57	
58	    def summary(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
59	        case_event = next((e for e in self.events if e["type"] == "case"), None)
60	        findings = [e["finding"] for e in self.events if e["type"] == "finding"]
61	        brief = next(
62	            (
63	                e["artifact"]["data"]
64	                for e in reversed(self.events)
65	                if e["type"] == "artifact" and e["artifact"]["id"] == "brief:brief"
66	            ),
67	            {},
68	        )
69	
70	        return {
71	            "id": self.id,
72	            "filename": self.filename,
73	            "created": self.created,
74	            "status": self.status,
75	            "findings": len(findings),
76	            "warnings": sum(f["severity"] in ("warning", "critical") for f in findings),
77	            "case": case_event["case"] if case_event else None,
78	            "verdict": brief.get("verdict"),
79	            "summary_plain": brief.get("summary_plain"),
80	        }

83	class CaseStore:
84	    def __init__(self, root: str):
85	        self.root = root
86	        self.cases: dict[str, Case] = {}
87	        os.makedirs(root, exist_ok=True)
88	        self._load_existing()
89	
90	    def _load_existing(self) -> None:
91	        for case_id in sorted(os.listdir(self.root)):
92	            workdir = os.path.join(self.root, case_id)
93	            meta_path = os.path.join(workdir, "case.json")
94	
95	            if not os.path.isfile(meta_path):
96	                continue
97	
98	            with open(meta_path) as handle:
99	                meta = json.load(handle)
100	
101	            case = Case(case_id, workdir, meta["filename"], meta.get("options", {}))
102	            case.created = meta.get("created", case.created)
103	            events_path = os.path.join(workdir, "events.jsonl")
104	
105	            if os.path.isfile(events_path):
106	                with open(events_path) as handle:
107	                    case.events = [json.loads(line) for line in handle if line.strip()]
108	
109	            done = any(e["type"] == "done" for e in case.events)
110	            case.status = "done" if done else "interrupted"
111	            self.cases[case_id] = case
112	
113	    def create(self, filename: str, options: dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> Case:
114	        case_id = time.strftime("%Y%m%d-%H%M%S-") + uuid.uuid4().hex[:6]
115	        workdir = os.path.join(self.root, case_id)
116	        os.makedirs(workdir)
117	        case = Case(case_id, workdir, os.path.basename(filename), options or {})
118	
119	        with open(os.path.join(workdir, "case.json"), "w") as handle:
120	            json.dump(
121	                {
122	                    "filename": case.filename,
123	                    "created": case.created,
124	                    "options": case.options,
125	                },
126	                handle,
127	            )
128	
129	        self.cases[case_id] = case
130	
131	        return case
132	
133	    def delete(self, case_id: str) -> bool:
134	        case = self.cases.pop(case_id, None)
135	
136	        if case is None:
137	            return False
138	
139	        if case.task and not case.task.done():
140	            case.task.cancel()
141	
142	        shutil.rmtree(case.workdir, ignore_errors=True)
143	
144	        return True

146	    async def sync_index(self) -> None:
147	        """Backfill the database index with every case on disk."""
148	        for case in list(self.cases.values()):
149	            await db.index_case(case)
150	
151	    def start(self, case: Case, *, only: list[str] | None = None) -> None:
152	        case.task = asyncio.create_task(run_case(case, only=only))

155	async def _make_proxy(case: Case) -> str | None:
156	    """An H.264 copy every browser can play (phones record HEVC/VP9)."""
157	    out = os.path.join(case.workdir, "proxy.mp4")
158	
159	    if os.path.isfile(out):
160	        return out
161	
162	    result = await run_tool(
163	        "ffmpeg", "-nostdin", "-v", "error", "-y", "-i", case.evidence_path,
164	        "-map", "0:v:0?", "-map", "0:a:0?",
165	        "-vf", "scale='min(1280,iw)':-2",
166	        "-c:v", "libx264", "-preset", "veryfast", "-crf", "23", "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p",
167	        "-c:a", "aac", "-b:a", "128k", "-movflags", "+faststart", out,
168	    )  # fmt: skip

173	async def _thumbnail(case: Case) -> None:
174	    await run_tool(
175	        "ffmpeg", "-nostdin", "-v", "error", "-y", "-ss", "0.5", "-i", case.evidence_path,
176	        "-frames:v", "1", "-vf", "scale=320:-2,format=yuvj420p", os.path.join(case.workdir, "thumb.jpg"),
177	    )  # fmt: skip
