180	def _hash_file(path: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
181	    sha, md5 = hashlib.sha256(), hashlib.md5()
182	
183	    with open(path, "rb") as handle:
184	        while chunk := handle.read(1 << 20):
185	            sha.update(chunk)
186	            md5.update(chunk)
187	
188	    return sha.hexdigest(), md5.hexdigest()
189	
190	
191	def _fps(text: str | None) -> float | None:
192	    if not text or text in ("0/0", "N/A"):
193	        return None
194	
195	    num, _, den = text.partition("/")
196	
197	    return round(float(num) / float(den), 3) if den and float(den) else float(num)
198	
199	
200	def _num(value: Any) -> float | None:
201	    try:
202	        return float(value)
203	    except TypeError, ValueError:
204	        return None
205	
206	
207	async def _custody(case: "Case", probe: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
208	    """Chain-of-custody facts: hashes, container, every stream, every tag."""
209	    sha256, md5 = await asyncio.to_thread(_hash_file, case.evidence_path)
210	    fmt = probe.get("format", {})
211	    tags: dict[str, str] = {}
212	
213	    for key, value in fmt.get("tags", {}).items():
214	        tags[key] = str(value)
215	
216	    for stream in probe.get("streams", []):
217	        for key, value in stream.get("tags", {}).items():
218	            tags.setdefault(f"stream{stream.get('index')}.{key}", str(value))
219	
220	    streams = [
221	        {
222	            "index": s.get("index"),
223	            "type": s.get("codec_type"),
224	            "codec": s.get("codec_name"),
225	            "codec_long": s.get("codec_long_name"),
226	            "profile": s.get("profile"),
227	            "width": s.get("width"),
228	            "height": s.get("height"),
229	            "fps": _fps(s.get("avg_frame_rate"))
230	            if s.get("codec_type") == "video"
231	            else None,
232	            "pix_fmt": s.get("pix_fmt"),
233	            "color_range": s.get("color_range"),
234	            "color_space": s.get("color_space"),
235	            "bit_rate": _num(s.get("bit_rate")),
236	            "sample_rate": _num(s.get("sample_rate")),
237	            "channels": s.get("channels"),
238	            "channel_layout": s.get("channel_layout"),
239	            "language": s.get("tags", {}).get("language"),
240	            "handler": s.get("tags", {}).get("handler_name"),
241	            "duration_s": _num(s.get("duration")),
242	            "frames": _num(s.get("nb_frames")),
243	        }
244	        for s in probe.get("streams", [])
245	    ]
246	
247	    return {
248	        "sha256": sha256,
249	        "md5": md5,
250	        "ingested_at": case.created,
251	        "container": {
252	            "format_name": fmt.get("format_name"),
253	            "format_long_name": fmt.get("format_long_name"),
254	            "bit_rate": _num(fmt.get("bit_rate")),
255	            "size_bytes": _num(fmt.get("size")),
256	            "duration_s": _num(fmt.get("duration")),
257	        },
258	        "streams": streams,
259	        "tags": tags,
260	    }
261	
262	
263	async def _index(case: Case) -> None:
264	    # The files are the record of the run; a database hiccup must not sink it.
265	    try:
266	        await db.index_case(case)
267	    except (psycopg.Error, OSError) as error:
268	        case.emit(
269	            {"type": "log", "module": "index",
270	             "message": f"database index not updated: {type(error).__name__}: {error}"}
271	        )  # fmt: skip
272	
273	
274	async def run_case(case: Case, *, only: list[str] | None = None) -> None:
275	    case.status = "running"
276	    # Mark the case running in the index without holding up the analysis.
277	    started_index = asyncio.create_task(_index(case))
278	    ctx = CaseContext(case.id, case.evidence_path, case.workdir, case.options)
279	    case.ctx = ctx
280	    probe = await ctx.probe()
281	    info = await ctx.video_info()
282	    has_audio = any(s.get("codec_type") == "audio" for s in probe.get("streams", []))
283	    modules = [m for m in registry.all_modules() if only is None or m.name in only]
284	
285	    # Modules not scheduled in this run count as finished with nothing to say,
286	    # so anything waiting on them carries on immediately.
287	    for other in registry.all_modules():
288	        if other.name not in {m.name for m in modules}:
289	            ctx.publish(other.name, None)
290	    proxy_task = asyncio.create_task(_make_proxy(case))
291	    await _thumbnail(case)
292	    case.emit(
293	        {
294	            "type": "case",
295	            "case": {
296	                "id": case.id,
297	                "filename": case.filename,
298	                "duration_s": float(probe.get("format", {}).get("duration") or 0),
299	                "size_bytes": int(probe.get("format", {}).get("size") or 0),
300	                "has_audio": has_audio,
301	                "video": None
302	                if info is None
303	                else {
304	                    "width": info.width,
305	                    "height": info.height,
306	                    "fps": round(info.fps, 3),
307	                    "codec": info.codec,
308	                    "frames": info.frame_count,
309	                },
310	                "thumb_url": f"/api/cases/{case.id}/files/thumb.jpg",
311	                "media_url": None,
312	                **(await _custody(case, probe)),
313	                "modules": [
314	                    {"name": m.name, "title": m.title, "description": m.description}
315	                    for m in modules
316	                ],
317	            },
318	        }
319	    )
320	
321	    for module in modules:
322	        case.emit(
323	            {"type": "module", "module": module.name, "status": "queued", "progress": 0}
324	        )
325	
326	    # Heavy modules are numpy/OpenCV bound; a small limit keeps the UI lively.
327	    gate = asyncio.Semaphore(int(os.environ.get("EARWITNESS_PARALLEL", "4")))
328	
329	    async def one(module: Any) -> None:
330	        reporter = Reporter(module.name, ctx, case.emit)
331	        depends = list(getattr(module, "depends", ()))
332	
333	        if depends == ["*"]:
334	            depends = [m.name for m in modules if m.name != module.name]
335	
336	        if depends:
337	            case.emit(
338	                {"type": "module", "module": module.name, "status": "waiting",
339	                 "progress": 0, "message": "waiting for " + ", ".join(depends)}
340	            )  # fmt: skip
341	
342	        for dependency in depends:
343	            if any(m.name == dependency for m in modules):
344	                await ctx.wait_for(dependency)
345	
346	        started = time.time()
347	
348	        async with gate:
349	            case.emit(
350	                {
351	                    "type": "module",
352	                    "module": module.name,
353	                    "status": "running",
354	                    "progress": 0,
355	                }
356	            )
357	
358	            try:
359	                await module.run(ctx, reporter)
360	            except Skip as reason:
361	                ctx.publish(module.name, None)
362	                case.emit(
363	                    {"type": "module", "module": module.name, "status": "skipped",
364	                     "progress": 1, "message": str(reason)}

1	"""Pixel-level tampering cues on selected frames.
2	
3	- Error level analysis: re-compress the frame and see which regions change.
4	  Areas pasted in from elsewhere often recompress differently.
5	- Noise residual: every camera leaves a uniform grain; a region with
6	  noticeably different grain was processed separately (blurred, pasted,
7	  generated). Video codecs reshape grain too, so these maps are for an
8	  examiner's eye and are not turned into findings.
9	- Copy-move: identical keypoint patterns at two places in one frame (cloned
10	  objects or patched-over areas).
11	"""
12	
13	import asyncio
14	from typing import Any
15	
16	import cv2
17	import numpy as np
18	
19	from earwitness.modules.base import CaseContext
20	from earwitness.modules.base import Reporter
21	from earwitness.modules.base import Skip
22	
23	_WIDTH = 960
24	_BLOCK = 24
25	_SAMPLES = 6
26	
27	
28	def _heat(base: np.ndarray, heat: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
29	    heat = np.clip(heat, 0, 1)
30	    colour = cv2.applyColorMap((heat * 255).astype(np.uint8), cv2.COLORMAP_INFERNO)
31	    colour = cv2.resize(
32	        colour, (base.shape[1], base.shape[0]), interpolation=cv2.INTER_NEAREST
33	    )
34	    bgr = cv2.cvtColor(base, cv2.COLOR_RGB2BGR)
35	    alpha = cv2.resize(heat, (base.shape[1], base.shape[0]))[..., None] * 0.75
36	
37	    return (bgr * (1 - alpha) + colour * alpha).astype(np.uint8)
38	
39	
40	def _ela(frame: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
41	    bgr = cv2.cvtColor(frame, cv2.COLOR_RGB2BGR)
42	    _, encoded = cv2.imencode(".jpg", bgr, [cv2.IMWRITE_JPEG_QUALITY, 90])
43	    again = cv2.imdecode(encoded, cv2.IMREAD_COLOR)
44	    diff = (
45	        np.abs(bgr.astype(np.int16) - again.astype(np.int16))
46	        .max(axis=2)
47	        .astype(np.float32)
48	    )
49	
50	    return cv2.blur(diff, (5, 5))
51	
52	
53	def _blocks(values: np.ndarray, block: int) -> np.ndarray:
54	    h, w = values.shape[0] // block, values.shape[1] // block
55	
56	    return (
57	        values[: h * block, : w * block].reshape(h, block, w, block).mean(axis=(1, 3))
58	    )
59	
60	
61	def _noise_map(frame: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
62	    gray = cv2.cvtColor(frame, cv2.COLOR_RGB2GRAY).astype(np.float32)
63	    residual = gray - cv2.medianBlur(gray.astype(np.uint8), 3).astype(np.float32)
64	    energy = _blocks(np.abs(residual), _BLOCK)
65	    # Grain depends on brightness and texture; compare like with like.
66	    brightness = _blocks(gray, _BLOCK)
67	    texture = _blocks(
68	        np.abs(cv2.Laplacian(cv2.GaussianBlur(gray, (0, 0), 2), cv2.CV_32F)), _BLOCK
69	    )
70	    design = np.stack(
71	        [
72	            np.ones_like(brightness),
73	            brightness / 255,
74	            (brightness / 255) ** 2,
75	            np.log1p(texture),
76	        ],
77	        axis=-1,
78	    )
79	    flat_design = design.reshape(-1, design.shape[-1])
80	    target = np.log1p(energy.reshape(-1))
81	    coeffs, *_ = np.linalg.lstsq(flat_design, target, rcond=None)
82	    residual_map = (target - flat_design @ coeffs).reshape(energy.shape)
83	    mad = np.median(np.abs(residual_map - np.median(residual_map))) * 1.4826 + 1e-6
84	    # Ignore saturated / black blocks: no grain there anyway.
85	    valid = (brightness > 12) & (brightness < 243)
86	
87	    return np.where(valid, (residual_map - np.median(residual_map)) / mad, 0.0)
88	
89	
90	def _copy_move(
91	    frame: np.ndarray,
92	) -> tuple[list[tuple[tuple[int, int], tuple[int, int]]], tuple[int, int] | None]:
93	    gray = cv2.cvtColor(frame, cv2.COLOR_RGB2GRAY)
94	    orb = cv2.ORB_create(nfeatures=3000, fastThreshold=12)
95	    keypoints, descriptors = orb.detectAndCompute(gray, None)
96	
97	    if descriptors is None or len(keypoints) < 50:
98	        return [], None
99	
100	    matcher = cv2.BFMatcher(cv2.NORM_HAMMING)
101	    matches = matcher.knnMatch(descriptors, descriptors, k=3)
102	    pairs = []
103	
104	    for group in matches:
105	        for match in group[1:]:
106	            if match.distance > 32:
107	                continue
108	
109	            a = np.array(keypoints[match.queryIdx].pt)
110	            b = np.array(keypoints[match.trainIdx].pt)
111	
112	            if np.linalg.norm(a - b) > 40:
113	                pairs.append((a, b))
114	
115	    if len(pairs) < 10:
116	        return [], None
117	
118	    offsets = np.array([np.round((b - a) / 6) for a, b in pairs]).astype(int)
119	    keys, counts = np.unique(offsets, axis=0, return_counts=True)
120	    best = int(np.argmax(counts))
121	
122	    if counts[best] < 14:
123	        return [], None
124	
125	    offset = keys[best]
126	    # A pasted clone puts nearly all self-matches on one offset (and its mirror).
127	    # Repeated real objects (lamps, windows, keys, tiles) match at many offsets.
128	    mirror = np.all(keys == -offset, axis=1)
129	    on_offset = counts[best] + (counts[mirror].sum() if mirror.any() else 0)
130	
131	    if on_offset < 0.5 * len(pairs):
132	        return [], None
133	    chosen = [
134	        (tuple(map(int, a)), tuple(map(int, b)))
135	        for (a, b), o in zip(pairs, offsets)
136	        if np.abs(o - offset).max() <= 1
137	    ]
138	    sources = np.array([c[0] for c in chosen])
139	    # Repetitive texture (tiles, windows, text) repeats at many offsets; a clone
140	    # is one compact patch moved once.
141	    spread = np.ptp(sources, axis=0)
142	
143	    if spread.max() > 0.5 * max(frame.shape[:2]) or len(chosen) < 14:
144	        return [], None
145	
146	    return chosen, (int(offset[0] * 6), int(offset[1] * 6))
147	
148	
149	def _analyse(frame: np.ndarray) -> dict[str, Any]:
150	    ela = _ela(frame)
151	    ela_blocks = _blocks(ela, _BLOCK)
152	    ela_z = (ela_blocks - np.median(ela_blocks)) / (
153	        np.median(np.abs(ela_blocks - np.median(ela_blocks))) * 1.4826 + 1e-6
154	    )
155	    noise_z = _noise_map(frame)
156	    pairs, offset = _copy_move(frame)
157	    noise_hot = np.abs(noise_z) > 4.5
158	    # Only clustered anomalies matter; isolated blocks are texture.
159	    count, labels, stats, _ = cv2.connectedComponentsWithStats(
160	        noise_hot.astype(np.uint8), connectivity=8
161	    )
162	    regions = [
163	        {
164	            "x": int(s[0]) * _BLOCK,
165	            "y": int(s[1]) * _BLOCK,
166	            "w": int(s[2]) * _BLOCK,
167	            "h": int(s[3]) * _BLOCK,
168	            "blocks": int(s[4]),
169	        }
170	        for s in stats[1:]
171	        if s[4] >= 6
172	    ]
173	
174	    return {
175	        "ela": ela,
176	        "ela_z": ela_z,
177	        "noise_z": noise_z,
178	        "regions": sorted(regions, key=lambda r: -r["blocks"]),
179	        "noise_fraction": float(noise_hot.mean()),
180	        "copy_move": pairs,
181	        "copy_offset": offset,
182	    }
183	
184	
185	class Tamper:
186	    name = "tamper"
187	    title = "PIXEL FORENSICS"
188	    description = "Error-level analysis, noise-residual consistency and copy-move detection on key frames."
189	    depends = ["timeline"]
190	
191	    async def run(self, ctx: CaseContext, out: Reporter) -> None:
192	        info = await ctx.video_info()
193	
194	        if info is None:
195	            raise Skip("no video stream")
196	
197	        timeline = await ctx.wait_for("timeline") or {}
198	        duration = max(info.duration_s, 0.1)
199	        times = list(np.linspace(0.5, max(0.5, duration - 0.5), _SAMPLES))
200	
201	        for cut in (timeline.get("cuts") or [])[:4]:
202	            times += [max(0.0, cut - 0.2), cut + 0.2]
203	
204	        times = sorted({round(t, 2) for t in times})
205	        width = min(_WIDTH, info.width)
206	        flagged = 0
207	        published: dict[str, Any] = {"frames": []}
208	
209	        for number, time_s in enumerate(times):
210	            out.progress(0.05 + 0.9 * number / len(times), f"frame @ {time_s:.2f}s")
211	            frame = await ctx.frame_at(time_s, width=width)
212	
213	            if frame is None:
214	                continue
215	
216	            result = await asyncio.to_thread(_analyse, frame)
217	            noise_heat = np.clip(np.abs(result["noise_z"]) / 8, 0, 1).astype(np.float32)
218	            ela_heat = np.clip(
219	                result["ela"] / (np.percentile(result["ela"], 99.5) + 1e-6), 0, 1
220	            ).astype(np.float32)
221	            stem = f"{number:02d}_{time_s:07.2f}"
222	            noise_path = out.path(f"noise_{stem}.jpg")
223	            ela_path = out.path(f"ela_{stem}.jpg")
224	            cv2.imwrite(
225	                noise_path, _heat(frame, noise_heat), [cv2.IMWRITE_JPEG_QUALITY, 85]
226	            )
227	            cv2.imwrite(
228	                ela_path, _heat(frame, ela_heat), [cv2.IMWRITE_JPEG_QUALITY, 85]
229	            )

231	                f"noise_{stem}", "heatmap", f"Noise-residual map @ {time_s:.2f}s",
232	                file=noise_path, time_s=time_s, data={"caption": "bright = grain unlike the rest of the frame"},
233	            )  # fmt: skip
234	            out.artifact(
235	                f"ela_{stem}", "heatmap", f"Error-level analysis @ {time_s:.2f}s",
236	                file=ela_path, time_s=time_s, data={"caption": "bright = recompresses differently"},
237	            )  # fmt: skip

"""Pixel-level tampering cues on selected frames.

- Error level analysis: re-compress the frame and see which regions change.
  Areas pasted in from elsewhere often recompress differently.
- Noise residual: every camera leaves a uniform grain; a region with
  noticeably different grain was processed separately (blurred, pasted,
  generated). Video codecs reshape grain too, so these maps are for an
  examiner's eye and are not turned into findings.
- Copy-move: identical keypoint patterns at two places in one frame (cloned
  objects or patched-over areas).
"""

import asyncio
from typing import Any

import cv2
import numpy as np

from earwitness.modules.base import CaseContext
from earwitness.modules.base import Reporter
from earwitness.modules.base import Skip

_WIDTH = 960
_BLOCK = 24
_SAMPLES = 6


def _heat(base: np.ndarray, heat: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    heat = np.clip(heat, 0, 1)
    colour = cv2.applyColorMap((heat * 255).astype(np.uint8), cv2.COLORMAP_INFERNO)
    colour = cv2.resize(
        colour, (base.shape[1], base.shape[0]), interpolation=cv2.INTER_NEAREST
    )
    bgr = cv2.cvtColor(base, cv2.COLOR_RGB2BGR)
    alpha = cv2.resize(heat, (base.shape[1], base.shape[0]))[..., None] * 0.75

    return (bgr * (1 - alpha) + colour * alpha).astype(np.uint8)


def _ela(frame: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    bgr = cv2.cvtColor(frame, cv2.COLOR_RGB2BGR)
    _, encoded = cv2.imencode(".jpg", bgr, [cv2.IMWRITE_JPEG_QUALITY, 90])
    again = cv2.imdecode(encoded, cv2.IMREAD_COLOR)
    diff = (
        np.abs(bgr.astype(np.int16) - again.astype(np.int16))
        .max(axis=2)
        .astype(np.float32)
    )

    return cv2.blur(diff, (5, 5))


def _blocks(values: np.ndarray, block: int) -> np.ndarray:
    h, w = values.shape[0] // block, values.shape[1] // block

    return (
        values[: h * block, : w * block].reshape(h, block, w, block).mean(axis=(1, 3))
    )


def _noise_map(frame: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    gray = cv2.cvtColor(frame, cv2.COLOR_RGB2GRAY).astype(np.float32)
    residual = gray - cv2.medianBlur(gray.astype(np.uint8), 3).astype(np.float32)
    energy = _blocks(np.abs(residual), _BLOCK)
    # Grain depends on brightness and texture; compare like with like.
    brightness = _blocks(gray, _BLOCK)
    texture = _blocks(
        np.abs(cv2.Laplacian(cv2.GaussianBlur(gray, (0, 0), 2), cv2.CV_32F)), _BLOCK
    )
    design = np.stack(
        [
            np.ones_like(brightness),
            brightness / 255,
            (brightness / 255) ** 2,
            np.log1p(texture),
        ],
        axis=-1,
    )
    flat_design = design.reshape(-1, design.shape[-1])
    target = np.log1p(energy.reshape(-1))
    coeffs, *_ = np.linalg.lstsq(flat_design, target, rcond=None)
    residual_map = (target - flat_design @ coeffs).reshape(energy.shape)
    mad = np.median(np.abs(residual_map - np.median(residual_map))) * 1.4826 + 1e-6
    # Ignore saturated / black blocks: no grain there anyway.
    valid = (brightness > 12) & (brightness < 243)

    return np.where(valid, (residual_map - np.median(residual_map)) / mad, 0.0)


def _copy_move(
    frame: np.ndarray,
) -> tuple[list[tuple[tuple[int, int], tuple[int, int]]], tuple[int, int] | None]:
    gray = cv2.cvtColor(frame, cv2.COLOR_RGB2GRAY)
    orb = cv2.ORB_create(nfeatures=3000, fastThreshold=12)
    keypoints, descriptors = orb.detectAndCompute(gray, None)

    if descriptors is None or len(keypoints) < 50:
        return [], None

    matcher = cv2.BFMatcher(cv2.NORM_HAMMING)
    matches = matcher.knnMatch(descriptors, descriptors, k=3)
    pairs = []

    for group in matches:
        for match in group[1:]:
            if match.distance > 32:
                continue

            a = np.array(keypoints[match.queryIdx].pt)
            b = np.array(keypoints[match.trainIdx].pt)

            if np.linalg.norm(a - b) > 40:
                pairs.append((a, b))

    if len(pairs) < 10:
        return [], None

    offsets = np.array([np.round((b - a) / 6) for a, b in pairs]).astype(int)
    keys, counts = np.unique(offsets, axis=0, return_counts=True)
    best = int(np.argmax(counts))

    if counts[best] < 14:
        return [], None

    offset = keys[best]
    # A pasted clone puts nearly all self-matches on one offset (and its mirror).
    # Repeated real objects (lamps, windows, keys, tiles) match at many offsets.
    mirror = np.all(keys == -offset, axis=1)
    on_offset = counts[best] + (counts[mirror].sum() if mirror.any() else 0)

    if on_offset < 0.5 * len(pairs):
        return [], None
    chosen = [
        (tuple(map(int, a)), tuple(map(int, b)))
        for (a, b), o in zip(pairs, offsets)
        if np.abs(o - offset).max() <= 1
    ]
    sources = np.array([c[0] for c in chosen])
    # Repetitive texture (tiles, windows, text) repeats at many offsets; a clone
    # is one compact patch moved once.
    spread = np.ptp(sources, axis=0)

    if spread.max() > 0.5 * max(frame.shape[:2]) or len(chosen) < 14:
        return [], None

    return chosen, (int(offset[0] * 6), int(offset[1] * 6))


def _analyse(frame: np.ndarray) -> dict[str, Any]:
    ela = _ela(frame)
    ela_blocks = _blocks(ela, _BLOCK)
    ela_z = (ela_blocks - np.median(ela_blocks)) / (
        np.median(np.abs(ela_blocks - np.median(ela_blocks))) * 1.4826 + 1e-6
    )
    noise_z = _noise_map(frame)
    pairs, offset = _copy_move(frame)
    noise_hot = np.abs(noise_z) > 4.5
    # Only clustered anomalies matter; isolated blocks are texture.
    count, labels, stats, _ = cv2.connectedComponentsWithStats(
        noise_hot.astype(np.uint8), connectivity=8
    )
    regions = [
        {
            "x": int(s[0]) * _BLOCK,
            "y": int(s[1]) * _BLOCK,
            "w": int(s[2]) * _BLOCK,
            "h": int(s[3]) * _BLOCK,
            "blocks": int(s[4]),
        }
        for s in stats[1:]
        if s[4] >= 6
    ]

    return {
        "ela": ela,
        "ela_z": ela_z,
        "noise_z": noise_z,
        "regions": sorted(regions, key=lambda r: -r["blocks"]),
        "noise_fraction": float(noise_hot.mean()),
        "copy_move": pairs,
        "copy_offset": offset,
    }


class Tamper:
    name = "tamper"
    title = "PIXEL FORENSICS"
    description = "Error-level analysis, noise-residual consistency and copy-move detection on key frames."
    depends = ["timeline"]

    async def run(self, ctx: CaseContext, out: Reporter) -> None:
        info = await ctx.video_info()

        if info is None:
            raise Skip("no video stream")

        timeline = await ctx.wait_for("timeline") or {}
        duration = max(info.duration_s, 0.1)
        times = list(np.linspace(0.5, max(0.5, duration - 0.5), _SAMPLES))

        for cut in (timeline.get("cuts") or [])[:4]:
            times += [max(0.0, cut - 0.2), cut + 0.2]

        times = sorted({round(t, 2) for t in times})
        width = min(_WIDTH, info.width)
        flagged = 0
        published: dict[str, Any] = {"frames": []}

        for number, time_s in enumerate(times):
            out.progress(0.05 + 0.9 * number / len(times), f"frame @ {time_s:.2f}s")
            frame = await ctx.frame_at(time_s, width=width)

            if frame is None:
                continue

            result = await asyncio.to_thread(_analyse, frame)
            noise_heat = np.clip(np.abs(result["noise_z"]) / 8, 0, 1).astype(np.float32)
            ela_heat = np.clip(
                result["ela"] / (np.percentile(result["ela"], 99.5) + 1e-6), 0, 1
            ).astype(np.float32)
            stem = f"{number:02d}_{time_s:07.2f}"
            noise_path = out.path(f"noise_{stem}.jpg")
            ela_path = out.path(f"ela_{stem}.jpg")
            cv2.imwrite(
                noise_path, _heat(frame, noise_heat), [cv2.IMWRITE_JPEG_QUALITY, 85]
            )
            cv2.imwrite(
                ela_path, _heat(frame, ela_heat), [cv2.IMWRITE_JPEG_QUALITY, 85]
            )
            out.artifact(
                f"noise_{stem}", "heatmap", f"Noise-residual map @ {time_s:.2f}s",
                file=noise_path, time_s=time_s, data={"caption": "bright = grain unlike the rest of the frame"},
            )  # fmt: skip
            out.artifact(
                f"ela_{stem}", "heatmap", f"Error-level analysis @ {time_s:.2f}s",
                file=ela_path, time_s=time_s, data={"caption": "bright = recompresses differently"},
            )  # fmt: skip
            published["frames"].append(
                {
                    "time_s": time_s,
                    "regions": result["regions"][:5],
                    "noise_fraction": result["noise_fraction"],
                }
            )

            if result["copy_move"]:
                flagged += 1
                image = cv2.cvtColor(frame, cv2.COLOR_RGB2BGR).copy()

                for a, b in result["copy_move"][:150]:
                    cv2.line(image, a, b, (80, 220, 255), 1, cv2.LINE_AA)
                    cv2.circle(image, a, 3, (60, 60, 255), -1)
                    cv2.circle(image, b, 3, (60, 255, 120), -1)

                path = out.path(f"clone_{stem}.jpg")
                cv2.imwrite(path, image)
                out.artifact(
                    f"clone_{stem}",
                    "image",
                    f"Copy-move matches @ {time_s:.2f}s",
                    file=path,
                    time_s=time_s,
                )
                out.finding(
                    "warning",
                    f"Cloned region @ {time_s:.2f}s",
                    f"{len(result['copy_move'])} identical feature points repeat at a fixed offset "
                    f"{result['copy_offset']} px within one frame. Cloning stamps one area over another "
                    "to hide or duplicate something. Repetitive real patterns can also do this.",
                    time_s=time_s,
                    tags=["tamper", "clone"],
                    data={
                        "offset": result["copy_offset"],
                        "matches": len(result["copy_move"]),
                    },
                )

        if not flagged:
            out.finding(
                "info",
                f"No cloned regions in {len(times)} sampled frames",
                "No patch of any sampled frame reappears elsewhere in the same frame. Error-level "
                "and grain heatmaps are attached for visual inspection; on phone video, compression "
                "itself shapes them, so they are not scored automatically.",
                tags=["tamper"],
            )

        ctx.publish(self.name, published)
        out.progress(1.0)

"""Who made this file, when, where, and has it been through other software?

Reads container tags, the top-level MP4/QuickTime box layout and stream facts.
Phones write a recognisable layout; editors and social apps rewrite it.
"""

import asyncio
import math
import os
import re
import struct
from datetime import datetime
from datetime import timedelta
from datetime import timezone
from typing import Any

import httpx

from earwitness.modules.base import CaseContext
from earwitness.modules.base import Reporter

_ISO6709 = re.compile(r"([+-]\d+(?:\.\d+)?)([+-]\d+(?:\.\d+)?)([+-]\d+(?:\.\d+)?)?")
_FILENAME_TIME = re.compile(r"(20\d{2})(\d{2})(\d{2})[_-]?(\d{2})(\d{2})(\d{2})")
_CONTAINER_BOXES = {
    b"moov",
    b"trak",
    b"mdia",
    b"minf",
    b"stbl",
    b"udta",
    b"edts",
    b"dinf",
}

# Software fingerprints in tags / handler names.
_SIGNATURES = [
    (re.compile(r"lavf|libavformat", re.I), "FFmpeg (libavformat)", "editor"),
    (re.compile(r"handbrake", re.I), "HandBrake", "editor"),
    (re.compile(r"premiere|adobe", re.I), "Adobe software", "editor"),
    (re.compile(r"capcut|bytedance", re.I), "CapCut / ByteDance", "editor"),
    (re.compile(r"davinci|resolve", re.I), "DaVinci Resolve", "editor"),
    (re.compile(r"imovie|final cut", re.I), "Apple iMovie / Final Cut", "editor"),
    (re.compile(r"whatsapp", re.I), "WhatsApp", "social"),
    (re.compile(r"telegram", re.I), "Telegram", "social"),
    (re.compile(r"google", re.I), "Google (Photos/Android)", "platform"),
    (re.compile(r"core media", re.I), "Apple Core Media (camera)", "camera"),
]


def _boxes(
    path: str, start: int = 0, end: int | None = None, depth: int = 0
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    """Walk the ISO-BMFF box tree (top level and the usual containers)."""
    out: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    end = end if end is not None else os.path.getsize(path)

    with open(path, "rb") as handle:
        offset = start

        while offset + 8 <= end and len(out) < 400:
            handle.seek(offset)
            header = handle.read(16)

            if len(header) < 8:
                break

            size, kind = struct.unpack(">I4s", header[:8])
            header_len = 8

            if size == 1 and len(header) >= 16:
                size = struct.unpack(">Q", header[8:16])[0]
                header_len = 16
            elif size == 0:
                size = end - offset

            if size < header_len or not re.fullmatch(rb"[ -~]{4}", kind):
                break

            box = {
                "type": kind.decode("latin-1"),
                "offset": offset,
                "size": size,
                "depth": depth,
            }
            out.append(box)

            if kind in _CONTAINER_BOXES and depth < 4:
                out.extend(_boxes(path, offset + header_len, offset + size, depth + 1))

            offset += size

    return out


def _parse_time(value: str | None) -> datetime | None:
    if not value:
        return None

    text = value.strip().replace("Z", "+00:00")

    # QuickTime writes "+0000" without a colon.
    text = re.sub(r"([+-]\d{2})(\d{2})$", r"\1:\2", text)

    try:
        parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(text)
    except ValueError:
        return None

    return parsed if parsed.tzinfo else parsed.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)


def sun_position(
    when: datetime, latitude: float, longitude: float
) -> tuple[float, float]:
    """Solar elevation and azimuth in degrees (NOAA approximation, ~0.5°)."""
    utc = when.astimezone(timezone.utc)
    day = utc.timetuple().tm_yday
    hour = utc.hour + utc.minute / 60 + utc.second / 3600
    gamma = 2 * math.pi / 365 * (day - 1 + (hour - 12) / 24)
    equation = 229.18 * (
        0.000075 + 0.001868 * math.cos(gamma) - 0.032077 * math.sin(gamma)
        - 0.014615 * math.cos(2 * gamma) - 0.040849 * math.sin(2 * gamma)
    )  # fmt: skip
    declination = (
        0.006918 - 0.399912 * math.cos(gamma) + 0.070257 * math.sin(gamma)
        - 0.006758 * math.cos(2 * gamma) + 0.000907 * math.sin(2 * gamma)
        - 0.002697 * math.cos(3 * gamma) + 0.00148 * math.sin(3 * gamma)
    )  # fmt: skip
    true_solar = hour * 60 + equation + 4 * longitude
    hour_angle = math.radians(true_solar / 4 - 180)
    lat = math.radians(latitude)
    cos_zenith = math.sin(lat) * math.sin(declination) + math.cos(lat) * math.cos(
        declination
    ) * math.cos(hour_angle)
    zenith = math.acos(max(-1.0, min(1.0, cos_zenith)))
    elevation = 90 - math.degrees(zenith)
    azimuth = math.degrees(
        math.atan2(
            math.sin(hour_angle),
            math.cos(hour_angle) * math.sin(lat)
            - math.tan(declination) * math.cos(lat),
        )
    )

    return elevation, (azimuth + 180) % 360


async def _reverse_geocode(latitude: float, longitude: float) -> str | None:
    if os.environ.get("EARWITNESS_OFFLINE"):
        return None

    try:
        async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=6.0) as client:
            response = await client.get(
                "https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/reverse",
                params={
                    "lat": latitude,
                    "lon": longitude,
                    "format": "jsonv2",
                    "zoom": 17,
                },
                headers={"User-Agent": "earwitness-forensics/0.1"},
            )

        if response.status_code != 200:
            return None

        return response.json().get("display_name")
    except httpx.HTTPError, ValueError:
        return None


class Provenance:
    name = "provenance"
    title = "PROVENANCE"
    description = "Container metadata, device, GPS, software fingerprints, box layout."

    async def run(self, ctx: CaseContext, out: Reporter) -> None:
        probe = await ctx.probe()
        fmt = probe.get("format", {})
        streams = probe.get("streams", [])
        tags: dict[str, str] = {}

        for section in [fmt, *streams]:
            for key, value in section.get("tags", {}).items():
                tags.setdefault(key.lower(), str(value))

        out.progress(0.2, "reading tags")
        out.artifact("probe", "json", "Raw container report (ffprobe)", data=probe)
        out.artifact(
            "tags",
            "table",
            "Container tags",
            data={"rows": [[k, v] for k, v in sorted(tags.items())]},
        )
        out.artifact(
            "streams",
            "table",
            "Streams",
            data={
                "rows": [
                    [
                        s.get("index"),
                        s.get("codec_type"),
                        s.get("codec_name"),
                        s.get("profile", ""),
                        f"{s.get('width', '')}x{s.get('height', '')}"
                        if s.get("width")
                        else s.get("sample_rate", ""),
                        s.get("bit_rate", ""),
                        s.get("duration", ""),
                        s.get("tags", {}).get("handler_name", ""),
                    ]
                    for s in streams
                ],
                "columns": [
                    "#",
                    "type",
                    "codec",
                    "profile",
                    "size/rate",
                    "bitrate",
                    "duration",
                    "handler",
                ],
            },
        )

        make = (
            tags.get("com.apple.quicktime.make")
            or tags.get("make")
            or tags.get("com.android.manufacturer")
        )
        model = (
            tags.get("com.apple.quicktime.model")
            or tags.get("model")
            or tags.get("com.android.model")
        )
        software = (
            tags.get("com.apple.quicktime.software")
            or tags.get("software")
            or tags.get("com.android.version")
        )
        published: dict[str, Any] = {"make": make, "model": model, "software": software}

        if make or model:
            out.finding(
                "info",
                f"Recorded on {' '.join(x for x in (make, model) if x)}",
                f"Device tags name the camera{f'; firmware/software {software}' if software else ''}.",
                tags=["device"],
                data={"make": make, "model": model, "software": software},
            )

        # ---- software fingerprints ---------------------------------------
        texts = " | ".join(
            [tags.get("encoder", ""), tags.get("handler_name", ""), tags.get("compatible_brands", ""),
             tags.get("major_brand", ""), *[s.get("tags", {}).get("handler_name", "") for s in streams],
             *[s.get("tags", {}).get("encoder", "") for s in streams]]
        )  # fmt: skip
        seen: set[str] = set()

        for pattern, label, role in _SIGNATURES:
            if pattern.search(texts) and label not in seen:
                seen.add(label)

                if role == "camera":
                    continue

                out.finding(
                    "warning" if role == "editor" else "notice",
                    f"Processed by {label}",
                    f"A tag or handler name carries the fingerprint of {label}. "
                    + (
                        "Camera-original files do not; the file was re-muxed or re-encoded."
                        if role != "platform"
                        else "Android's recorder and Google Photos exports both write it; "
                        "check the codec (VP9/AV1 means a Photos re-encode)."
                    ),
                    tags=["software", role],
                    data={"evidence": texts[:400]},
                )

        published["software_seen"] = sorted(seen)

        # ---- box layout -----------------------------------------------------
        out.progress(0.4, "walking box tree")
        boxes = await asyncio.to_thread(_boxes, ctx.path)
        top = [b["type"] for b in boxes if b["depth"] == 0]
        published["boxes"] = top

        if boxes:
            out.artifact(
                "boxes",
                "table",
                "Box (atom) layout",
                data={
                    "columns": ["depth", "type", "offset", "size"],
                    "rows": [
                        [b["depth"], b["type"], b["offset"], b["size"]]
                        for b in boxes[:200]
                    ],
                },
            )

            if "moov" in top and "mdat" in top:
                moov_first = top.index("moov") < top.index("mdat")
                apple = bool(tags.get("com.apple.quicktime.make"))

                if moov_first and apple:
                    out.finding(
                        "warning",
                        "Box layout rewritten",
                        "The moov index sits before the media data. iPhone camera originals "
                        "write it at the end; something re-saved this file (export, upload, editor).",
                        tags=["container"],
                        data={"top_level": top},
                    )
                elif not moov_first and not any(
                    role == "editor" for _, label, role in _SIGNATURES if label in seen
                ):
                    out.finding(
                        "info",
                        "Camera-style box layout",
                        "Index (moov) follows the media (mdat), as a recorder that writes "
                        "while filming leaves it. Consistent with an original file.",
                        tags=["container"],
                        data={"top_level": top},
                    )
                else:
                    out.finding(
                        "notice",
                        "Streaming-optimised layout",
                        "moov precedes mdat ('faststart'). Typical of web uploads, messaging "
                        "apps and editors; camera originals usually differ.",
                        tags=["container"],
                        data={"top_level": top},
                    )

        # ---- time ---------------------------------------------------------------
        out.progress(0.6, "reconciling clocks")
        duration = float(fmt.get("duration") or 0)
        apple_date_raw = tags.get("com.apple.quicktime.creationdate")
        apple_date = _parse_time(apple_date_raw)
        creation = _parse_time(tags.get("creation_time")) or apple_date
        filename = ctx.options.get("original_name") or os.path.basename(ctx.path)
        found = _FILENAME_TIME.search(filename)
        file_local = None

        if found:
            try:
                file_local = datetime(*(int(g) for g in found.groups()))
            except ValueError:
                file_local = None

        times: dict[str, Any] = {
            "creation_time_utc": creation,
            "apple_creationdate": apple_date_raw,
            "filename_local": file_local,
            "duration_s": duration,
        }

        if apple_date_raw and (
            offset := re.search(r"([+-]\d{2}):?(\d{2})$", apple_date_raw)
        ):
            hours = int(offset.group(1))
            times["utc_offset_h"] = hours + math.copysign(
                int(offset.group(2)) / 60, hours
            )

        if creation is not None:
            out.finding(
                "info",
                f"Container clock: {creation:%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S} UTC",
                "creation_time from the container. Phones often stamp the END of the "
                f"recording; if so it began at {(creation - timedelta(seconds=duration)):%H:%M:%S} UTC.",
                tags=["time"],
                data=times,
            )

        if creation is not None and file_local is not None:
            naive = creation.replace(tzinfo=None)
            best = None

            for anchor_name, anchor in (
                ("start", naive - timedelta(seconds=duration)),
                ("end", naive),
            ):
                delta_h = (file_local - anchor).total_seconds() / 3600
                rounded = round(delta_h * 4) / 4
                residual = abs(delta_h - rounded) * 3600

                if best is None or residual < best[2]:
                    best = (anchor_name, rounded, residual)

            anchor_name, offset_h, residual = best

            if residual <= 5 and abs(offset_h) <= 14:
                times["utc_offset_h"] = offset_h
                times["creation_time_marks"] = (
                    "end" if anchor_name == "start" else "start"
                )
                out.finding(
                    "notice",
                    f"Local clock was UTC{offset_h:+g}",
                    f"Filename time {file_local:%H:%M:%S} (local) and container time agree "
                    f"to {residual:.0f} s at a UTC{offset_h:+g} offset. The filename stamps the "
                    f"recording {'start' if anchor_name == 'start' else 'end'}, and the container "
                    f"stamps the {'end' if anchor_name == 'start' else 'start'}.",
                    tags=["time", "timezone"],
                    data={"offset_h": offset_h, "residual_s": residual},
                )
            else:
                out.finding(
                    "warning",
                    "Filename and container clocks disagree",
                    f"Filename says {file_local} local, container {creation} UTC, and no whole "
                    "time-zone offset reconciles them. The file was renamed, re-exported, or a clock was set.",
                    tags=["time", "inconsistency"],
                    data={"residual_s": residual, "offset_h": offset_h},
                )

        if creation is None and not make:
            out.finding(
                "notice",
                "Metadata stripped",
                "No creation time and no device tags. Social platforms and messaging apps "
                "strip these; camera originals keep them.",
                tags=["metadata"],
            )

        # Apps and downloaders stamp the moment they save a copy. A camera-less
        # file whose clock reads "just now" is dated by the copy, not the filming.
        times["copy_stamp"] = False

        if creation is not None and not (make or model):
            age_h = (datetime.now(timezone.utc) - creation).total_seconds() / 3600

            if -1 <= age_h <= 72:
                times["copy_stamp"] = True
                out.finding(
                    "warning",
                    "Timestamp is when this copy was made",
                    f"The file claims {creation:%Y-%m-%d %H:%M} UTC, only {max(age_h, 0):.1f} h before it "
                    "was examined, and it carries no camera make or model. Apps, messengers and "
                    "downloaders write the moment they save a copy, so this is not when it was filmed.",
                    tags=["time", "metadata"],
                    data={"age_hours": age_h},
                )

        published["times"] = times
        start_guess = None

        if creation is not None and not times["copy_stamp"]:
            start_guess = (
                creation - timedelta(seconds=duration)
                if times.get("creation_time_marks", "end") == "end"
                else creation
            )

        published["start_guess"] = start_guess
        # Which end of the recording the container stamps is device-dependent.
        published["start_candidates"] = (
            []
            if creation is None
            else [creation - timedelta(seconds=duration), creation]
        )

        # ---- streams ------------------------------------------------------------
        durations = {
            s.get("codec_type"): float(s["duration"])
            for s in streams
            if s.get("duration") not in (None, "N/A")
            and s.get("codec_type") in ("audio", "video")
        }

        if "audio" in durations and "video" in durations:
            gap = durations["audio"] - durations["video"]

            if abs(gap) > 0.25:
                out.finding(
                    "notice",
                    f"Audio and video lengths differ by {abs(gap):.2f} s",
                    f"Audio runs {durations['audio']:.2f} s and video {durations['video']:.2f} s. "
                    "Cameras keep them within a frame or two. Editing or re-muxing can leave a gap.",
                    tags=["streams"],
                    data=durations,
                )

        # ---- place ---------------------------------------------------------------
        out.progress(0.8, "locating")
        location_text = (
            tags.get("com.apple.quicktime.location.iso6709")
            or tags.get("location")
            or tags.get("location-eng")
        )
        accuracy = tags.get("com.apple.quicktime.location.accuracy.horizontal")
        published["location"] = None

        if location_text and (match := _ISO6709.match(location_text)):
            latitude, longitude = float(match.group(1)), float(match.group(2))
            altitude = float(match.group(3)) if match.group(3) else None
            accuracy_m = float(accuracy) if accuracy else None
            place = await _reverse_geocode(latitude, longitude)
            published["location"] = {
                "lat": latitude, "lon": longitude, "alt_m": altitude,
                "accuracy_m": accuracy_m, "place": place,
            }  # fmt: skip
            out.finding(
                "critical",
                f"GPS fix: {latitude:.5f}, {longitude:.5f}",
                (f"{place}. " if place else "")
                + "The file carries the phone's location"
                + (f" (±{accuracy_m:.0f} m)" if accuracy_m else "")
                + (f", altitude {altitude:.0f} m" if altitude is not None else "")
                + ".",
                tags=["location", "gps"],
                data=published["location"],
            )
            out.artifact(
                "map",
                "map",
                "Where",
                data={
                    "points": [
                        {"lat": latitude, "lon": longitude, "label": "GPS (metadata)",
                         "accuracy_m": accuracy_m, "kind": "gps"}
                    ]
                },
            )  # fmt: skip

            if start_guess is not None:
                elevation, azimuth = sun_position(start_guess, latitude, longitude)
                published["sun"] = {"elevation": elevation, "azimuth": azimuth}
                phase = (
                    "daylight" if elevation > 6 else
                    "golden hour / civil twilight" if elevation > -6 else
                    "nautical twilight" if elevation > -12 else "night"
                )  # fmt: skip
                out.finding(
                    "info",
                    f"Sun {elevation:+.0f}° elevation, azimuth {azimuth:.0f}° ({phase})",
                    "Computed from the claimed time and GPS fix. Scene lighting should match; "
                    "the LIGHT module checks this against the footage.",
                    tags=["sun", "time", "location"],
                    data=published["sun"] | {"phase": phase},
                )

        ctx.publish(self.name, published)
        out.progress(1.0)

523	def _local_brief(findings: list[Finding]) -> dict[str, Any]:

"""The case summary: WHEN / WHERE / WHO / INTEGRITY / HIDDEN.

Always produced locally from the measured findings with explicit rules, so the
verdict is reproducible. With an OpenAI key, a language model also writes a
short narrative brief that must cite finding IDs.
"""

import json
import re
from datetime import datetime
from datetime import timedelta
from typing import Any

from earwitness import openai_client
from earwitness.modules.base import CaseContext
from earwitness.modules.base import Finding
from earwitness.modules.base import Reporter

_EDIT_TAGS = {"splice", "cut", "inconsistency", "clone"}


def _with(findings: list[Finding], *tags: str, measured: bool = True) -> list[Finding]:
    return [
        f
        for f in findings
        if set(tags) & set(f.tags) and (not measured or f.kind == "measured")
    ]


def _clock(seconds: float | None) -> str:
    if seconds is None:
        return ""

    return f"{int(seconds // 60)}:{int(seconds % 60):02d}"


def _answer(key, question, answer, confidence, evidence, time_s=None):
    return {
        "key": key,
        "question": question,
        "answer": answer,
        "confidence": confidence,
        "evidence": [f.id for f in evidence],
        "time_s": time_s,
        "ai": any(f.kind == "inferred" for f in evidence),
    }


def _plain_answers(
    findings: list[Finding], local: dict[str, Any]
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    """The case in plain English: one question per card, with a confidence word."""
    by_title = lambda *prefixes: [f for f in findings if f.title.startswith(prefixes)]  # noqa: E731
    answers = []

    # ---- edited? ----------------------------------------------------------
    edits = [
        f
        for f in findings
        if f.kind == "measured"
        and f.severity in ("warning", "critical")
        and ({"splice", "cut", "clone", "sync"} & set(f.tags))
    ]
    software = [f for f in findings if "editor" in f.tags]
    corroborated = by_title("Edit corroborated")
    first = min(
        (f for f in edits if f.time_s is not None), key=lambda f: f.time_s, default=None
    )

    contradicted_time = by_title("Metadata time contradicted")

    if corroborated:
        at = corroborated[0].time_s
        others = [
            f
            for f in edits
            if f.time_s is not None and at is not None and abs(f.time_s - at) > 1.5
        ]
        answer = f"Yes. Both the picture and the sound break at {_clock(at)}: two independent signs of a cut."

        if others:
            answer += (
                f" There {'are' if len(others) > 1 else 'is'} {len(others)} more suspicious "
                f"spot{'s' if len(others) > 1 else ''}, first at {_clock(min(f.time_s for f in others))}."
            )

        answers.append(
            _answer(
                "edited",
                "Has this video been edited?",
                answer,
                "strong",
                corroborated + edits[:3],
                at,
            )
        )
    elif edits:
        kinds = []

        for f in edits:
            label = (
                "the picture jumps between shots" if "cut" in f.tags
                else "part of the image was copied and pasted" if "clone" in f.tags
                else "the sound is out of step with the picture" if "sync" in f.tags
                else "the sound was cut and joined"
            )  # fmt: skip

            if label not in kinds:
                kinds.append(label)

        answer = (
            "Yes: "
            + "; ".join(kinds[:3])
            + (f" (first at {_clock(first.time_s)})" if first else "")
            + "."
        )
        strong = len({f.module for f in edits}) >= 2 or any(
            f.severity == "critical" for f in edits
        )
        answers.append(
            _answer(
                "edited",
                "Has this video been edited?",
                answer,
                "strong" if strong else "moderate",
                edits[:4],
                first.time_s if first else None,
            )
        )
    elif contradicted_time:
        answers.append(_answer(
            "edited", "Has this video been edited?",
            "The picture and sound were not cut, but the date stored in the file does not match "
            "when it was really filmed: the timestamp is wrong or was changed.",
            "strong", contradicted_time + software[:1],
        ))  # fmt: skip
    elif software:
        answers.append(_answer(
            "edited", "Has this video been edited?",
            "No cuts or splices found, but the file has been re-saved by other software, "
            "so it is not the camera's original.",
            "moderate", software[:2],
        ))  # fmt: skip
    else:
        checks = [
            f
            for f in findings
            if f.title.startswith(
                ("No hard cuts", "Steady", "Regular keyframe", "No cloned")
            )
        ]
        answers.append(_answer(
            "edited", "Has this video been edited?",
            "No signs of editing. The frames, sound and pixels are all consistent with one continuous recording.",
            "moderate" if len(checks) >= 2 else "weak", checks[:3],
        ))  # fmt: skip

    # ---- when? ----------------------------------------------------------------
    dated = by_title("ENF dates", "Lighting dates")
    contradicted = by_title("Metadata time contradicted")
    container = by_title("Container clock")

    if dated:
        moment = dated[0].title.split(" to ", 1)[-1]
        how = (
            "the flicker of the room's lights"
            if dated[0].title.startswith("Lighting")
            else "the hum of the power grid in the sound"
        )
        extra = " The time written in the file is wrong." if contradicted else ""
        answers.append(
            _answer(
                "when",
                "When was it filmed?",
                f"{moment}, worked out from {how}, matched against the national grid's records.{extra}",
                "strong",
                dated + contradicted,
            )
        )
    elif by_title("Timestamp is when this copy was made"):
        copy = by_title("Timestamp is when this copy was made")
        answers.append(
            _answer(
                "when",
                "When was it filmed?",
                "Unknown. The only date in the file is when this copy was saved or "
                "downloaded, not when it was filmed.",
                "unknown",
                copy + container,
            )
        )
    elif container:
        when = container[0].title.split(": ", 1)[-1]
        stamp = container[0].data.get("creation_time_utc")
        local = by_title("Local clock was UTC")

        if stamp:
            moment = datetime.fromisoformat(str(stamp))
            when = f"{moment:%-d %B %Y, %H:%M} UTC"

            if local:
                shifted = moment + timedelta(hours=float(local[0].data["offset_h"]))
                when = f"{shifted:%-d %B %Y, %H:%M} local time ({moment:%H:%M} UTC)"

        answers.append(
            _answer(
                "when",
                "When was it filmed?",
                f"The file says {when}. This comes from the file's own label, which can be changed, so it is not proven.",
                "weak",
                container + local,
            )
        )
    else:
        answers.append(
            _answer(
                "when",
                "When was it filmed?",
                "Not enough evidence. The file carries no date, and no time clues were found in the sound or light.",
                "unknown",
                [],
            )
        )

    # ---- where? ---------------------------------------------------------------
    gps = [f for f in findings if "gps" in f.tags]
    postcode = [
        f for f in findings if "text" in f.tags and "postcode" in f.title.lower()
    ]
    grid = [
        f
        for f in findings
        if f.title.startswith(("Lights flicker", "Mains hum locked"))
        and f.severity == "critical"
    ]
    geo_guess = [
        f
        for f in findings
        if f.module == "geo"
        and f.title.startswith(("Pixels say", "Located", "Pixels suggest"))
    ]
    ai_place = geo_guess or [
        f
        for f in findings
        if f.kind == "inferred"
        and "location" in f.tags
        and f.title.startswith("Looks like")
    ]

    resaved = bool(by_title("Timestamp is when this copy was made"))

    if gps and resaved:
        place = gps[0].data.get("place") or gps[0].title.split(": ", 1)[-1]
        answers.append(
            _answer(
                "where",
                "Where was it filmed?",
                f"{place}, from GPS saved in the file. This is a re-saved copy, so the GPS "
                "may mark where it was saved rather than filmed.",
                "moderate",
                gps,
            )
        )
    elif gps:
        place = gps[0].data.get("place") or gps[0].title.split(": ", 1)[-1]
        answers.append(
            _answer(
                "where",
                "Where was it filmed?",
                f"{place}, from the phone's GPS saved in the file.",
                "strong",
                gps,
            )
        )
    elif postcode:
        answers.append(
            _answer(
                "where",
                "Where was it filmed?",
                f"Near postcode {postcode[0].data.get('value')}, which is readable in the picture.",
                "moderate",
                postcode,
                postcode[0].time_s,
            )
        )
    elif ai_place:
        guess = ai_place[0]

        if guess.module == "geo":
            parts = (
                guess.data.get("place"),
                guess.data.get("region"),
                guess.data.get("country"),
            )
            place = ", ".join(
                str(p) for p in parts if p and not str(p).lower().startswith("unknown")
            )
            radius = float(guess.data.get("radius_km") or 0)
            near = f"within about {radius:.0f} km" if radius >= 1 else "very close"
            place = re.sub(
                r"^(best guess:|likely|probably|possibly)\s*", "", place, flags=re.I
            )
            answer = f"Probably {place} ({near}), judging only from what is visible in the picture."
            check = guess.data.get("corroboration") or {}

            if check.get("agree"):
                answer += (
                    " Verified: it matches reference photos and satellite imagery of the place."
                    if guess.data.get("verified")
                    else " A second, independent AI analysis agrees."
                )
            elif check:
                other = str(check.get("second_guess") or "no location")
                answer = (
                    f"Uncertain. One AI analysis suggests {place}; a second "
                    + (
                        "could not place it at all."
                        if other.lower().startswith(("unknown", "no location"))
                        else f"suggests {other}."
                    )
                    + " Treat this as a lead, not an answer."
                )
        else:
            answer = re.sub(
                r"\s*\((low|medium|high) confidence\)",
                "",
                guess.title.removeprefix("Looks like: "),
            )
            answer += ", judging from what is visible."

        confidence = {"high": "moderate", "medium": "moderate"}.get(
            guess.data.get("confidence"), "weak"
        )

        if not (guess.data.get("corroboration") or {}).get("agree", True):
            confidence = "weak"

        # A guess spanning a continent or more is not a location.
        if float(guess.data.get("radius_km") or 0) >= 2500:
            answer = (
                "Not enough evidence. Nothing in the picture narrows it down "
                "(the AI's best guess would span thousands of kilometres)."
            )
            confidence = "unknown"

        answers.append(
            _answer("where", "Where was it filmed?", answer, confidence, [guess])
        )
    elif grid:
        region = (
            "Europe, the UK, Africa, most of Asia or Australia"
            if "50 Hz" in grid[0].title
            else "the Americas or parts of East Asia"
        )
        answers.append(
            _answer(
                "where",
                "Where was it filmed?",
                f"Somewhere in {region}: the electricity there runs at the frequency we detected.",
                "weak",
                grid,
            )
        )
    else:
        answers.append(
            _answer(
                "where",
                "Where was it filmed?",
                "Not enough evidence. No location data or recognisable clues were found.",
                "unknown",
                [],
            )
        )

    # ---- device -----------------------------------------------------------------
    device = by_title("Recorded on")

    if device:
        answers.append(
            _answer(
                "device",
                "What recorded it?",
                device[0].title.removeprefix("Recorded on ") + ".",
                "strong",
                device,
            )
        )

    # ---- people -----------------------------------------------------------------
    pulses = [f for f in findings if f.module == "pulse" and "bpm" in f.title]

    if pulses:
        best = max(pulses, key=lambda f: f.data.get("snr_db", -99))
        reliable = best.data.get("snr_db", -99) > 0
        answers.append(_answer(
            "people", "Who is in it?",
            (f"At least {len(pulses)} face{'' if len(pulses) == 1 else 's'} clearly visible. "
             if any("face" in f.title for f in pulses) else "Visible skin, but no face. ")
            + (f"We can see a heartbeat of about {best.data['bpm']:.0f} beats per minute from tiny colour changes in the skin."
               if reliable else "Heart rate could not be read reliably (movement or compression)."),
            "moderate" if reliable else "weak", pulses[:3], best.time_s,
        ))  # fmt: skip

    # ---- hidden -----------------------------------------------------------------
    hidden_bits, hidden_f = [], []

    for f in findings:
        if "dtmf" in f.tags:
            hidden_bits.append(
                f"phone keypad tones spelling {f.title.split(': ', 1)[-1]}"
            )
        elif "ultrasonic" in f.tags:
            hidden_bits.append(
                f"a high-pitched tone too high for adults to hear ({f.data.get('hz', 0) / 1000:.1f} kHz)"
            )
        elif "doppler" in f.tags:
            hidden_bits.append(
                "the sound of something passing by (aircraft or vehicle)"
            )
        elif f.title.startswith("Lights flicker"):
            hidden_bits.append(
                "an invisible flicker from mains-powered lights, which reveals the electricity grid"
            )
        else:
            continue

        hidden_f.append(f)

    if hidden_bits:
        unique = list(dict.fromkeys(hidden_bits))
        first_hidden = next((f.time_s for f in hidden_f if f.time_s is not None), None)
        answers.append(
            _answer(
                "hidden",
                "Anything you can't see or hear?",
                "Yes: " + "; ".join(unique[:4]) + ".",
                "strong",
                hidden_f[:4],
                first_hidden,
            )
        )
    else:
        answers.append(
            _answer(
                "hidden",
                "Anything you can't see or hear?",
                "Nothing unusual hidden in the sound or picture.",
                "moderate",
                [],
            )
        )

    # ---- text in the picture ----------------------------------------------------
    readable = [
        f
        for f in findings
        if f.module == "ocr" and f.severity in ("warning", "critical")
    ]

    if readable:
        values = list(dict.fromkeys(f.title.split(": ", 1)[-1] for f in readable))
        answers.append(
            _answer(
                "text",
                "Any readable text or numbers?",
                "Yes: " + "; ".join(values[:5]) + ".",
                "moderate",
                readable[:5],
                readable[0].time_s,
            )
        )

    # ---- speech -----------------------------------------------------------------
    speech = [
        f for f in findings if f.module == "transcript" and f.title.startswith("Speech")
    ]
    voices = [
        f
        for f in findings
        if f.module == "transcript" and f.title.startswith("Voices speaking")
    ]

    if voices and not speech:
        answers.append(
            _answer(
                "speech",
                "What is said?",
                f"People can be heard speaking {voices[0].data.get('language')}, but the words "
                "cannot be made out reliably.",
                "weak",
                voices,
            )
        )

    if speech:
        answers.append(
            _answer(
                "speech",
                "What is said?",
                speech[0].detail.removeprefix("First words: "),
                "moderate",
                speech,
                speech[0].time_s,
            )
        )

    return answers


def _summary_plain(answers: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> str:
    edited = next(a for a in answers if a["key"] == "edited")
    when = next(
        (a for a in answers if a["key"] == "when" and a["confidence"] == "strong"), None
    )
    text = edited["answer"]

    if when:
        text += " Filmed " + when["answer"].split(",", 1)[0] + "."

    return text


def _local_brief(findings: list[Finding]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    serious = [
        f
        for f in findings
        if f.severity in ("warning", "critical") and f.kind == "measured"
    ]
    edits = [f for f in serious if _EDIT_TAGS & set(f.tags)]
    software = [f for f in serious if "editor" in f.tags]
    independent_modules = {f.module for f in edits}

    hard_cuts = [f for f in edits if "cut" in f.tags]

    if (
        len(independent_modules) >= 2
        or any(f.severity == "critical" for f in edits)
        or hard_cuts
    ):
        verdict = "EDITED"
    elif edits or software:
        verdict = "POSSIBLY EDITED"
    else:
        verdict = "NO SIGNS OF EDITING"

    bullets: list[str] = []
    when = _with(findings, "enf") and [
        f
        for f in _with(findings, "enf", "time")
        if f.title.startswith(("ENF dates", "Lighting dates"))
    ]
    container = [f for f in findings if f.title.startswith("Container clock")]

    if when:
        bullets.append(f"WHEN: {when[0].title} [{when[0].id}]")
    elif container:
        bullets.append(
            f"WHEN: {container[0].title}, from metadata only, not independently verified [{container[0].id}]"
        )
    else:
        bullets.append("WHEN: no time evidence in the file")

    gps = _with(findings, "gps")
    postcode = [f for f in _with(findings, "text") if "postcode" in f.title.lower()]
    grid = [
        f
        for f in findings
        if ("flicker" in f.tags or "enf" in f.tags)
        and "grid" in f.title.lower()
        and f.severity == "critical"
    ]
    place_bits = []

    if gps:
        place_bits.append(f"{gps[0].title} [{gps[0].id}]")

    if postcode:
        place_bits.append(f"{postcode[0].title} [{postcode[0].id}]")

    if grid:
        place_bits.append(f"{grid[0].title} [{grid[0].id}]")

    inferred_place = [
        f for f in findings if f.kind == "inferred" and "location" in f.tags
    ]

    if inferred_place:
        place_bits.append(f"AI: {inferred_place[0].title} [{inferred_place[0].id}]")

    bullets.append(
        "WHERE: " + ("; ".join(place_bits) if place_bits else "no location evidence")
    )
    device = _with(findings, "device")
    people = [f for f in _with(findings, "pulse") if "bpm" in f.title]

    if device:
        bullets.append(f"DEVICE: {device[0].title} [{device[0].id}]")

    if people:
        bullets.append(
            "PEOPLE: " + "; ".join(f"{f.title} [{f.id}]" for f in people[:3])
        )

    if edits or software:
        bullets.append(
            "INTEGRITY: "
            + "; ".join(f"{f.title} [{f.id}]" for f in (edits + software)[:6])
        )
    else:
        bullets.append(
            "INTEGRITY: frame clock, keyframes, audio continuity and pixels show no edit"
        )

    hidden = [
        f
        for f in findings
        if {"dtmf", "ultrasonic", "tone", "doppler"} & set(f.tags)
        and f.severity != "info"
    ]

    if hidden:
        bullets.append(
            "HIDDEN: " + "; ".join(f"{f.title} [{f.id}]" for f in hidden[:4])
        )

    # Corroboration: an edit seen by two independent senses is much stronger.
    cut_times = [
        f.time_s for f in edits if f.time_s is not None and f.module == "timeline"
    ]
    audio_times = [
        f.time_s
        for f in edits
        if f.time_s is not None and f.module in ("spectrum", "enf")
    ]
    agreements = [(v, a) for v in cut_times for a in audio_times if abs(v - a) <= 1.5]

    if agreements:
        v, a = agreements[0]
        bullets.append(
            f"CORROBORATED: picture cut at {v:.1f}s and audio break at {a:.1f}s coincide"
        )

    text = f"VERDICT: {verdict}.\n" + "\n".join(bullets)

    return {
        "verdict": verdict,
        "bullets": bullets,
        "text": text,
        "corroborated": bool(agreements),
        "corroborated_at": agreements[0][0] if agreements else None,
    }


_SCHEMA = {
    "type": "object",
    "additionalProperties": False,
    "required": ["headline", "summary", "next_steps"],
    "properties": {
        "headline": {"type": "string", "description": "One line, max 90 characters."},

def _evidence(findings: list[Finding]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    return [
        {"id": f.id, "module": f.module, "severity": f.severity, "kind": f.kind,
         "title": f.title, "detail": f.detail, "time_s": f.time_s}
        for f in findings
    ]  # fmt: skip

_DOSSIER = (
    "You write the reveal at the end of a privacy demonstration: 'what this video gives away "
    "about the person who filmed it'. Address the filmer as 'you', in short, cold, specific "
    "sentences, like a surveillance file read aloud (e.g. 'You were on the South Bank, facing the "
    "London Eye.' 'Your phone is an iPhone 17 Pro Max.' 'Your heart was beating at 72 beats per "
    "minute.'). Use ONLY the findings provided, cite their ids, and mark certainty honestly: "
    "'measured' for signal measurements and metadata, 'likely' for verified or corroborated AI "
    "inferences, 'possible' for uncorroborated AI guesses. Order from most unsettling to least. "
    "Hard rules: never identify or name any person; never speculate about ethnicity, religion, "
    "health conditions, sexuality, politics or other sensitive traits; no threats; do not "
    "exaggerate beyond the evidence. Skip anything trivial. The closing line names what a "
    "stranger could do with this information (e.g. find the spot, know when you were there)."
)


class Brief:
    name = "brief"
    title = "CASE BRIEF"
    description = "Verdict and summary across all modules (rule-based; plus AI narrative if enabled)."
    depends = ["*"]

    async def run(self, ctx: CaseContext, out: Reporter) -> None:
        findings = list(ctx.findings)
        local = _local_brief(findings)

        if local["corroborated"]:
            out.finding(
                "critical",
                "Edit corroborated by sound and picture",
                local["bullets"][-1].removeprefix("CORROBORATED: ").capitalize()
                + ". Two independent measurements agree on an edit point.",
                time_s=local["corroborated_at"],
                tags=["splice", "inconsistency"],
            )

        data: dict[str, Any] = dict(local)
        data["answers"] = _plain_answers(ctx.findings, local)
        data["summary_plain"] = _summary_plain(data["answers"])

        if openai_client.enabled() and findings:
            out.progress(0.4, "drafting narrative")
            evidence = [
                {"id": f.id, "module": f.module, "severity": f.severity, "kind": f.kind,
                 "title": f.title, "detail": f.detail, "time_s": f.time_s}
                for f in findings
            ]  # fmt: skip

            try:
                narrative = await openai_client.structured(
                    ctx.workdir,
                    instructions=(
                        "You write the summary of a video-forensics case file for a non-expert. Use ONLY "
                        "the findings given; cite their ids in brackets. Distinguish measured findings "
                        "from AI-inferred ones. Do not overstate: weak evidence is weak. The rule-based "
                        f"verdict is '{local['verdict']}'; agree with it unless the findings clearly contradict it."
                    ),
                    content=[{"type": "input_text", "text": str(evidence)}],
                    schema=_SCHEMA,
                    name="case_brief",
                )
                data["headline"] = narrative["headline"]
                data["narrative"] = narrative["summary"]
                data["next_steps"] = narrative["next_steps"]
                data["text"] = (
                    f"{narrative['headline']}\n\n{narrative['summary']}\n\n{local['text']}"
                )
                data["model"] = narrative.get("_model")
            except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001 - the brief must still appear
                out.log(f"AI narrative unavailable: {error}")

        out.artifact("brief", "brief", "Case brief", data=data)

        if openai_client.enabled() and findings:
            out.progress(0.7, "writing the dossier")

            try:
                dossier = await openai_client.structured(
                    ctx.workdir,
                    instructions=_DOSSIER,
                    content=[
                        {
                            "type": "input_text",
                            "text": json.dumps(_evidence(findings), ensure_ascii=False),
                        }
                    ],
                    schema=_DOSSIER_SCHEMA,
                    name="dossier",
                )
                known = {f.id for f in findings}
                dossier["lines"] = [
                    line | {"evidence": [e for e in line["evidence"] if e in known]}
                    for line in dossier["lines"]
                    if any(e in known for e in line["evidence"])
                ]
                bpm = next(
                    (
                        f.data.get("bpm")
                        for f in findings
                        if f.module == "pulse" and f.data.get("bpm")
                    ),
                    None,
                )
                dossier["heart_bpm"] = bpm
                out.artifact(
                    "dossier", "dossier", "What this video gives away", data=dossier
                )
            except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001 - optional
                out.log(f"dossier unavailable: {error}")

        ctx.publish(self.name, data)
        out.progress(1.0)
